AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Serverless workflow - Step Functions sends custom events to a custom EventBridge bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.
Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-custom-bus"

  EventLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-event-log"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  EventRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LogEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn

  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-forward-all"
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ""
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn
          Id: EventLogTarget
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventRuleRole.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
        - PolicyName: XRayPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"

  SendEventStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-send-event-sfn"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Sends a custom event to the custom EventBridge bus
        StartAt: SendCustomEvent
        States:
          SendCustomEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:events:putEvents
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - EventBusName: ${EventBusName}
                  Source: app.custom
                  DetailType: CustomMessage
                  Detail.$: States.Stringify($)
            ResultPath: DISCARD
            End: true
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ERROR
        IncludeExecutionData: false
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt EventLogGroup.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true

Outputs:
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EventBusName"
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref SendEventStateMachine
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-StateMachineArn"
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group receiving all events
    Value: !Ref EventLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LogGroupName"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role and DLM lifecycle policy for daily EBS snapshots of volumes tagged TeemDLM=daily
Resources:
  DLMLifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dlm-lifecycle-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dlm-lifecycle-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CopyTags
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: dlm-lifecycle-role
  DLMLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::DLM::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Daily EBS snapshots for volumes tagged TeemDLM=daily
      State: ENABLED
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt DLMLifecycleRole.Arn
      PolicyDetails:
        ResourceTypes:
          - VOLUME
        TargetTags:
          - Key: TeemDLM
            Value: daily
        Schedules:
          - Name: DailySnapshots
            CreateRule:
              Interval: 24
              IntervalUnit: HOURS
              Times:
                - '01:00'
            RetainRule:
              Count: 7
            CopyTags: true

    Description: ARN of the DLM lifecycle role
    Value: !GetAtt DLMLifecycleRole.Arn

    Value: !Ref DLMLifecyclePolicy

Description: Serverless workflow monitoring EC2 instance state changes via EventBridge triggering a Step Functions state machine with logging.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ec2-state-monitor
    Description: Name prefix for resources.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention period for the state machine log group.

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/states/${ProjectName}-statemachine'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StepFunctionsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/states/${ProjectName}-statemachine'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-sfn-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-state-machine'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      Definition:
        Comment: Routes EC2 state change events to business logic placeholders
        StartAt: CheckInstanceState
        States:
          CheckInstanceState:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: running
                Next: RunningLogic
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: stopped
                Next: StoppedLogic
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: terminated
                Next: TerminatedLogic
            Default: UnknownState
          RunningLogic:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when instance is running
            Result: 'Placeholder: instance running business logic'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: Complete
          StoppedLogic:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when instance is stopped
            Result: 'Placeholder: instance stopped business logic'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: Complete
          TerminatedLogic:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for business logic when instance is terminated
            Result: 'Placeholder: instance terminated business logic'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: Complete
          UnknownState:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 'Placeholder: unhandled state'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: Complete
          Complete:
            Type: Succeed

    Properties:

        Statement:

      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: StepFunctionsTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instance: '$.detail.instance-id'
              state: '$.detail.state'
            InputTemplate: '{"detail":{"instance-id":<instance>,"state":<state>}}'

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine

    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule

                  - ecs:SubmitAttachmentStateChanges
                  - ecs:SubmitContainerStateChange
                  - ecs:SubmitTaskStateChange
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Idempotency store for hybrid mode deduplication (polling + event-driven workflows).
  Creates a DynamoDB table with composite primary key, TTL, and Point-in-Time Recovery,
  plus a managed IAM policy granting Lambda and Step Functions read/write access.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,40}$"
  TtlDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: >
      Number of days idempotency records should be retained before expiring.
      The writing application must set the 'expiresAt' attribute (epoch seconds)
      accordingly; DynamoDB TTL will delete expired items.

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: idempotencyKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: executionContext
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: idempotencyKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: executionContext
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store"
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: IdempotencyDeduplication

  IdempotencyAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-access"
      Description: >
        Read/write access to the idempotency DynamoDB table for Lambda and Step Functions.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableIndexAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
            Resource:
              - !Sub "${IdempotencyTable.Arn}/index/*"

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
  AccessPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed IAM policy for idempotency table access.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyAccessPolicy
  TtlDays:
    Description: Configured TTL retention in days for idempotency records.
    Value: !Ref TtlDays

Description: Creates Cognito User Pool and Identity Pool for Kibana access to an Elasticsearch domain.

Resources:
  KibanaUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: KibanaUsers
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

  KibanaUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: KibanaClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref KibanaUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ADMIN_NO_SRP_AUTH

  KibanaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: KibanaIDPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref KibanaUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt KibanaUserPool.ProviderName

  KibanaAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref KibanaIdentityPool
              'ForAnyValue:StringLike':
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KibanaESAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - es:ESHttp*
                Resource: '*'

  KibanaIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref KibanaIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt KibanaAuthenticatedRole.Arn

  KibanaElasticsearchDomain:
    Type: AWS::Elasticsearch::Domain
    Properties:
      DomainName: kibana-domain
      ElasticsearchVersion: '7.10'
      ElasticsearchClusterConfig:
        InstanceType: t3.small.elasticsearch
        InstanceCount: 1
        DedicatedMasterEnabled: false
        ZoneAwarenessEnabled: false
      EBSOptions:
        EBSEnabled: true
        VolumeSize: 10
        VolumeType: gp2
      CognitoOptions:
        Enabled: true
        IdentityPoolId: !Ref KibanaIdentityPool
        RoleArn: !GetAtt KibanaCognitoAccessRole.Arn
        UserPoolId: !Ref KibanaUserPool
      AccessPolicies:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt KibanaAuthenticatedRole.Arn
            Action:
              - es:ESHttp*
            Resource: '*'

  KibanaCognitoAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: es.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonESCognitoAccess

Outputs:

    Description: ID of the KibanaUsers Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref KibanaUserPool
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Chaos engineering workflow with Step Functions to test ECS service resilience

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC where the ECS instance will run
  SubnetId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: Subnet where the ECS instance will run
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: EC2 instance type for the ECS container instance
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address for SNS alerts
    AllowedPattern: "^[^@]+@[^@]+\\.[^@]+$"
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/amzn2-ami-hvm-x86_64-gp2

Resources:
  ECSSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS container instance
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: chaos-test-cluster

  ECSContainerInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref ECSSecurityGroup
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      UserData:
        Fn::Base64: !Sub |
          #!/bin/bash
          echo ECS_CLUSTER=${ECSCluster} >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: chaos-test-task
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - EC2
      NetworkMode: bridge
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '256'
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: nginx
          Image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nginx:latest
          Essential: true
          Memory: 128
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: chaos-test-service
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 100
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 0

  SNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: chaos-test-alerts

  SNSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref SNSTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChaosLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: arn:aws:logs:*:*:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SNSTopic

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: chaos-terminate-instance
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              instance_id = event.get('InstanceId')
              ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              return {
                  'InstanceId': instance_id,
                  'Status': 'Termination initiated'
              }

  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: chaos-ecs-health-check
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ECS_CLUSTER: !Ref ECSCluster
          ECS_SERVICE: !Ref ECSService
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SNSTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              sns = boto3.client('sns')
              cluster = os.environ['ECS_CLUSTER']
              service = os.environ['ECS_SERVICE']
              resp = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              svc = resp['services'][0]
              desired = svc['desiredCount']
              running = svc['runningCount']
              healthy = running >= desired
              if not healthy:
                  message = (
                      'ALERT: ECS service {} in cluster {} is unhealthy. '
                      'Desired: {}, Running: {}'
                  ).format(service, cluster, desired, running)
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=os.environ['SNS_TOPIC_ARN'],
                      Subject='ECS Chaos Test Alert',
                      Message=message
                  )
              return {
                  'Cluster': cluster,
                  'Service': service,
                  'DesiredCount': desired,
                  'RunningCount': running,
                  'Healthy': healthy
              }

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsInvokeLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: ecs-chaos-workflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Chaos engineering workflow for ECS resilience testing",
            "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
            "States": {
              "TerminateInstance": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${TerminateInstanceArn}",
                "Parameters": {
                  "InstanceId.$": "$.InstanceId"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.TerminateResult",
                "Next": "Wait300Seconds",
                "Catch": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                    "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                    "Next": "NotifyFailure"
                  }
                ]
              },
              "Wait300Seconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 300,
                "Next": "CheckServiceHealth"
              },
              "CheckServiceHealth": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${HealthCheckArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$.HealthCheck",
                "End": true,
                "Catch": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                    "ResultPath": "$.Error",
                    "Next": "NotifyFailure"
                  }
                ]
              },
              "NotifyFailure": {
                "Type": "Fail",
                "Error": "ChaosWorkflowFailed",
                "Cause": "The chaos engineering workflow encountered an error"
              }
            }
          }
        - TerminateInstanceArn: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
          HealthCheckArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the chaos engineering Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine
  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS alert topic
    Value: !Ref SNSTopic
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ChaosInstanceId:
    Description: EC2 instance ID to pass to the state machine for termination
    Value: !Ref ECSContainerInstance

Description: Creates SSM parameters, a Secrets Manager secret, and a Lambda that demonstrates reading them.

Resources:

  DemoParameter3:

    Properties:

      Type: String
      Value: '1.0.0'
      Description: Demo parameter 3

  DemoSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-demo-secret'
      Description: Demo secret with generated password
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username":"demo-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: 'password'
        PasswordLength: 24
        ExcludePunctuation: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ParameterStoreDemo-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterStoreDemoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Ref DemoSecret

  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - DemoParameter1
      - DemoParameter2
      - DemoParameter3
      - DemoSecret
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')
          secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ['STACK_NAME']
              path = f'/{stack_name}/'

              print(f'Stack name: {stack_name}')
              print(f'Retrieving SSM parameters under path: {path}')

              paginator = ssm.get_paginator('get_parameters_by_path')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=path, Recursive=True, WithDecryption=True):
                  for param in page['Parameters']:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates a custom SSM inventory collection mechanism to track running database and caching processes on Windows and Linux EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of Linux process keywords to search for.
  WindowsKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached'
    Description: Comma-separated list of Windows process keywords to search for.
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: 'rate(30 days)'
    Description: Schedule expression for the SSM association.

Resources:
  CustomInventoryProcessesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      Name: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Custom inventory collection of database and caching processes.
        parameters:
          linuxKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Linux process keywords.
          windowsKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Windows process keywords.
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: runLinuxScript
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  INVENTORY_DIR="/opt/aws/ssm/data/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"
                  INVENTORY_FILE="$INVENTORY_DIR/processes.json"
                  echo "{\"instanceId\":\"$INSTANCE_ID\",\"processes\":[" > "$INVENTORY_FILE"
                  FIRST=true
                  IFS=',' read -ra KEYWORDS <<< "{{ linuxKeywords }}"
                  for keyword in "${KEYWORDS[@]}"; do
                    PIDS=$(pgrep -f "$keyword" 2>/dev/null)
                    if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then
                      for pid in $PIDS; do
                        if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then
                          FIRST=false
                        else
                          echo "," >> "$INVENTORY_FILE"
                        fi
                        CMD=$(ps -p "$pid" -o command= 2>/dev/null)
                        echo "{\"keyword\":\"$keyword\",\"pid\":$pid,\"command\":\"$CMD\"}" >> "$INVENTORY_FILE"
                      done
                    fi
                  done
                  echo "]}" >> "$INVENTORY_FILE"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: runWindowsScript
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method PUT -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds"="21600"}
                  $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token"=$token}
                  $inventoryDir = "$env:ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\custom"
                  if (-not (Test-Path $inventoryDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $inventoryDir -Force | Out-Null }
                  $inventoryFile = Join-Path $inventoryDir "processes.json"
                  $results = @()
                  $keywords = "{{ windowsKeywords }}" -split ","
                  foreach ($keyword in $keywords) {
                    $processes = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like "*$keyword*" -or ($_.Path -and $_.Path -like "*$keyword*") }
                    foreach ($proc in $processes) {
                      $results += [PSCustomObject]@{
                        instanceId = $instanceId
                        keyword = $keyword
                        pid = $proc.Id
                        processName = $proc.ProcessName
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  $results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -Path $inventoryFile -Force

  CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      Parameters:
        linuxKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxKeywords
        windowsKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsKeywords
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - '*'
      WaitForSuccessTimeoutSeconds: 300

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Command document.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesDocument
  AssociationName:
    Description: Name of the SSM association.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryProcessesAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: App Mesh colorteller demo with gateway, router, and blue/green virtual nodes

Resources:
  Mesh:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DefaultVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true

  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
      Vpc: !Ref DefaultVPC

  ColorGateway:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualGateway
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
        BackendDefaults:
          ClientPolicy:
            TLS:
              Validation:
                Trust:
                  File:
                    CertificateChain: /etc/keys/caCert

  VirtualRouter:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http

  BlueVirtualNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-blue-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller

  GreenVirtualNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-green-node
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller

  VirtualService:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualService
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualServiceName: colorteller
      Spec:
        Provider:
          VirtualRouter:
            VirtualRouterName: !Ref VirtualRouter

  Route:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Ref Mesh
      VirtualRouterName: !Ref VirtualRouter
      RouteName: colorteller-route
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Match:
            Prefix: /
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:
              - VirtualNode: !Ref BlueVirtualNode
                Weight: 50
              - VirtualNode: !Ref GreenVirtualNode
                Weight: 50

Outputs:
  MeshName:
    Value: !Ref Mesh
  VirtualGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref ColorGateway
  VirtualServiceId:
    Value: !Ref VirtualService
  NamespaceId:
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace

Description: Private S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline with optional EMR log bucket and lifecycle rules.

Parameters:
  CreateEmrLogBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create the EMR log bucket.

Mappings:
  RegionToStorageClass:
    us-east-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-east-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-west-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    us-west-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-west-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-west-2:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    eu-west-3:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    eu-central-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    eu-north-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-southeast-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-southeast-2:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ap-northeast-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    ap-south-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    ca-central-1:
      StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
    sa-east-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER
    us-gov-west-1:
      StorageClass: GLACIER

Conditions:
  CreateEmrLogBucketCondition: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateEmrLogBucket
    - 'true'

Resources:
  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-source-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${SourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-target-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${TargetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  EmrLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-emrlogs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: TransitionAndExpireRule
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: !FindInMap
                  - RegionToStorageClass
                  - !Ref 'AWS::Region'
                  - StorageClass
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EmrLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref EmrLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${EmrLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

Outputs:
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the source bucket
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SourceBucketName'

  TargetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the target bucket
    Value: !Ref TargetBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TargetBucketName'

  EmrLogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the EMR log bucket
    Value: !If
      - CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
      - !Ref EmrLogBucket
      - 'NotCreated'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketName'

  EmrLogBucketDnsName:
    Description: Regional domain name (DNS) of the EMR log bucket
    Value: !If
      - CreateEmrLogBucketCondition
      - !Sub '${EmrLogBucket.RegionalDomainName}'
      - 'NotCreated'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketDnsName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automatically disable IMDSv1 on EC2 instances when they enter the running state using SSM Automation triggered by EventBridge.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata (1-64).

Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'SSM-ConfigureEC2Metadata-Role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EC2MetadataOptionsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'EventBridge-StartSSMAutomation-Role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

  EC2RunningStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'DisableIMDSv1-OnRunning-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Triggers AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation when an EC2 instance enters the running state.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: ConfigureEC2MetadataTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-document/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              InstanceId: '$.detail.instance-id'
            InputTemplate: !Sub
              - '{"InstanceId":["<InstanceId>"],"AutomationAssumeRole":["${RoleArn}"],"HttpTokens":["required"],"HttpPutResponseHopLimit":["${HopLimit}"]}'
              - RoleArn: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
                HopLimit: !Ref HttpPutResponseHopLimit

Outputs:
  EventRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers on EC2 running state.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2RunningStateRule.Arn
  SSMRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the SSM automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  EventBridgeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by EventBridge to start the automation.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Scheduled Lambda to clean up expired items from the DynamoDB throttle table
Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 hour)
    Description: Schedule for the cleanup (e.g. rate(1 hour)). Pass an empty string to disable scheduling.
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: throttle
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table to clean up
Conditions:
  HasSchedule:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, '']]
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: DynamoDBCleanupRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TableName}
  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              now = int(context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() and __import__('time').time())
              deleted = 0
              scan_kwargs = {
                  'FilterExpression': Attr('expiry').lt(now),
                  'ProjectionExpression': 'pk, #sk',
                  'ExpressionAttributeNames': {'#sk': 'sk'},
                  'ConsistentRead': False
              }
              while True:
                  response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  items = response.get('Items', [])
                  if items:
                      with table.batch_writer() as batch:
                          for item in items:
                              batch.delete_item(Key={'pk': item['pk'], 'sk': item['sk']})
                              deleted += 1
                  if 'LastEvaluatedKey' not in response:
                      break
                  scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = response['LastEvaluatedKey']
              print(f'Deleted {deleted} expired items from {TABLE_NAME}')
              return {'deleted': deleted}
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${DynamoDBCleanupFunction}
      RetentionInDays: 30
  CleanupScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Name: DynamoDBCleanupSchedule
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: DynamoDBCleanupTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn
Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the cleanup Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
  LambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

Description: Creates IoT SiteWise Turbine and Wind Farm asset models for a wind farm demo.
Resources:
  TurbineAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Turbine Demo Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind turbine with attributes, measurements, transforms and metrics.
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: location
          LogicalId: location
          Type: Attribute
          DataType: STRING
          Attribute:
            DefaultValue: Home Farm
        - Name: threshold
          LogicalId: threshold
          Type: Attribute
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Attribute:
            DefaultValue: '3'
        - Name: Wind Speed
          LogicalId: WindSpeed
          Type: Measurement
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
        - Name: Torque
          LogicalId: Torque
          Type: Measurement
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: Nm
        - Name: RPM
          LogicalId: RPM
          Type: Measurement
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: rpm
        - Name: Power
          LogicalId: Power
          Type: Measurement
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
        - Name: Overdrive State
          LogicalId: overdriveState
          Type: Transform
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Transform:
            Expression: gt(Torque, threshold)
            Variables:
              - Name: Torque
                Value: Torque
              - Name: threshold
                Value: threshold
        - Name: Average Wind Speed
          LogicalId: avgWindSpeed
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Metric:
            Expression: avg(WindSpeed)
            Variables:
              - Name: WindSpeed
                Value: WindSpeed
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
        - Name: Overdrive State Time
          LogicalId: overdriveStateTime
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: minutes
          Metric:
            Expression: sum(overdriveState)
            Variables:
              - Name: overdriveState
                Value: overdriveState
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
        - Name: Average Power
          LogicalId: avgPower
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Metric:
            Expression: avg(Power)
            Variables:
              - Name: Power
                Value: Power
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
  WindFarmAssetModel:
    Type: AWS::IoTSiteWise::AssetModel
    Properties:
      AssetModelName: Wind Farm Demo Asset Model
      AssetModelDescription: Represents a wind farm that rolls up turbine metrics over a 5 minute tumbling window.
      AssetModelProperties:
        - Name: location
          LogicalId: location
          Type: Attribute
          DataType: STRING
          Attribute:
            DefaultValue: Home Farm
        - Name: Total Average Power
          LogicalId: totalAvgPower
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: kW
          Metric:
            Expression: sum(avgPower)
            Variables:
              - Name: avgPower
                Value: avgPower
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
        - Name: Total Overdrive State Time
          LogicalId: totalOverdriveStateTime
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: minutes
          Metric:
            Expression: sum(overdriveStateTime)
            Variables:
              - Name: overdriveStateTime
                Value: overdriveStateTime
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
        - Name: Total Average Wind Speed
          LogicalId: totalAvgWindSpeed
          Type: Metric
          DataType: DOUBLE
          Unit: m/s
          Metric:
            Expression: sum(avgWindSpeed)
            Variables:
              - Name: avgWindSpeed
                Value: avgWindSpeed
            Window:
              Tumbling:
                Interval: 5m
      AssetModelHierarchies:
        - Name: Wind Turbines
          LogicalId: windTurbines
          ChildAssetModelId:
            Fn::GetAtt:
              - TurbineAssetModel
              - AssetModelId

      Fn::GetAtt:
        - WindFarmAssetModel

    Value: windTurbines

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates two Cognito identity pools with unauthenticated identities enabled.
  One pool is used for Lambda-based access and the other for Step Functions
  workflow-based access. Each pool has an IAM role attached as its
  unauthenticated role. The Lambda-facing role also supports Lambda service
  execution with permissions for Lambda invocation, DynamoDB and SES. The
  Step Functions-facing role also supports assumption by the Step Functions
  service with permissions to invoke Lambda functions.

Parameters:
  LambdaPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-test-identity-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool used for Lambda-based access.
    AllowedPattern: '[\w +=,.@-]+'
  StepFunctionsPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: stepfunctions-test-identity-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool used for Step Functions-based access.
    AllowedPattern: '[\w +=,.@-]+'
  LambdaRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: lambda-test-unauth-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role attached to the Lambda identity pool.
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
  StepFunctionsRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: stepfunctions-test-unauth-role
    Description: Name of the IAM role attached to the Step Functions identity pool.
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function(s) the roles may invoke. Use * for testing.
  DynamoDBTableArn:
    Type: String
    Default: '*'
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table the Lambda role may access. Use * for testing.

Resources:
  LambdaIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref LambdaPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  StepFunctionsIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref StepFunctionsPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  LambdaUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref LambdaRoleName
      Description: >
        Unauthenticated role for the Lambda identity pool. Also assumable by
        the Lambda service for function execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaUnauthRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:InvokeAsync
                Resource: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn
              - Sid: DynamoDBAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Ref DynamoDBTableArn
              - Sid: SesSendEmail
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  StepFunctionsUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref StepFunctionsRoleName
      Description: >
        Unauthenticated role for the Step Functions identity pool. Also
        assumable by the Step Functions service for workflow execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
          - Sid: StepFunctionsServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsUnauthRolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Ref LambdaFunctionArn

  LambdaIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt LambdaUnauthRole.Arn

  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt StepFunctionsUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  LambdaIdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool used for Lambda-based access.
    Value: !Ref LambdaIdentityPool
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool used for Step Functions-based access.
    Value: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPool
  LambdaUnauthRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated role attached to the Lambda identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaUnauthRole.Arn
  StepFunctionsUnauthRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated role attached to the Step Functions identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt StepFunctionsUnauthRole.Arn
  LambdaIdentityPoolRoleAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the role attachment for the Lambda identity pool.
    Value: !Ref LambdaIdentityPoolRoleAttachment
  StepFunctionsIdentityPoolRoleAttachmentId:
    Description: ID of the role attachment for the Step Functions identity pool.
    Value: !Ref StepFunctionsIdentityPoolRoleAttachment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to a target replica region using CodeBuild triggered by EventBridge.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target region for repository replicas.
  SourceRepo1:
    Type: String
    Default: card-service
  SourceRepo2:
    Type: String
    Default: rule-service
  SourceRepo3:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-pipeline

Resources:
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CodeBuildRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CodeBuildMirrorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo1}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo2}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo3}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo1}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo2}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo3}'

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EventBridgeStartBuildPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn

  MirrorBuildProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-project'
      Description: Mirrors CodeCommit repositories to the target replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildRole.Arn
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        Image: aws/codebuild/amazonlinux2-x86_64-standard:5.0
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
          - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
            Value: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Name: SOURCE_REGION
            Value: !Ref AWS::Region
          - Name: REPOS
            Value: !Sub '${SourceRepo1},${SourceRepo2},${SourceRepo3}'
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              commands:
                - pip3 install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  IFS=',' read -ra REPO_ARRAY <<< "$REPOS"
                  for REPO in "${REPO_ARRAY[@]}"; do
                    echo "Mirroring repository: $REPO"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit://${REPO}" "/tmp/${REPO}.git"
                    cd "/tmp/${REPO}.git"
                    git remote add replica "codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    git push --mirror "codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    cd /
                    rm -rf "/tmp/${REPO}.git"
                  done
      Triggers:
        Webhook: false

  CardServiceRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-card-service-mainline-rule'
      Description: Trigger mirror build on push to mainline of card-service.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo1}'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MirrorBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

  RuleServiceRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rule-service-mainline-rule'
      Description: Trigger mirror build on push to mainline of rule-service.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo2}'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MirrorBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

  EcsPipelineRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-pipeline-mainline-rule'
      Description: Trigger mirror build on push to mainline of ecs-pipeline.
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${SourceRepo3}'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: MirrorBuildTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn

Outputs:
  MirrorProjectName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild mirror project.
    Value: !Ref MirrorBuildProject
  MirrorProjectArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild mirror project.
    Value: !GetAtt MirrorBuildProject.Arn
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the CodeBuild artifact bucket.
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
  CardServiceRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the card-service EventBridge rule.
    Value: !GetAtt CardServiceRule.Arn
  RuleServiceRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the rule-service EventBridge rule.
    Value: !GetAtt RuleServiceRule.Arn
  EcsPipelineRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ecs-pipeline EventBridge rule.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsPipelineRule.Arn

        Status: Enabled

        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:

        Rules:

  AccessLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogsPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action:

            Resource: !Sub "${AccessLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}"
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: S3ServerAccessLogsPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}"
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-s3-replication-role"

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

      Policies:

                  - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl

                  - s3:ReplicateObject
                  - s3:ReplicateDelete
                  - s3:ReplicateTags
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn:
      - ReplicationRole
      - ReplicaBucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}"

        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:

        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:

            Filter:
              Prefix: ""
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
  PrimaryBucketPolicy:

    Properties:

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
