AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Automation infrastructure for Aurora Global Database failover using SSM Automation, ARC, and Lambda.
Parameters:
  PrimaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Primary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.
  SecondaryRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Secondary AWS region of the Aurora Global Database.
  GlobalClusterId:
    Type: String
    Description: The ID of the Aurora Global Database cluster.
  ControlPanelArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC control panel.
  RoutingControlArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Route 53 ARC routing control.
  SecretArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the writer endpoint.
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 120
    Description: Timeout in seconds for the TriggerFailover Lambda function.
Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                  - rds:ModifyGlobalCluster
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeControlPanel
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeRoutingControl
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:*:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: TriggerFailoverLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TriggerFailoverPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentName: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Failover an Aurora Global Database and update ARC routing controls.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role for the automation.
            default: ''
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Primary region of the global database.
            default: us-east-1
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            description: Secondary region of the global database.
            default: us-west-2
          GlobalClusterId:
            type: String
            description: Aurora Global Database cluster ID.
          ControlPanelArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the ARC control panel.
          RoutingControlArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the ARC routing control.
          SecretArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret with the writer endpoint.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary_region = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    routing_control_arn = event['RoutingControlArn']
                    arc = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=primary_region)
                    response = arc.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=routing_control_arn)
                    state = response['RoutingControlState']
                    active_region = primary_region if state == 'ON' else secondary_region
                    return {'activeRegion': active_region, 'routingControlState': state}
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                RoutingControlArn: '{{ RoutingControlArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.activeRegion
                Type: String
          - name: PerformGlobalFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    active_region = event['ActiveRegion']
                    secondary_region = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    global_cluster_id = event['GlobalClusterId']
                    target_region = secondary_region if active_region == event['PrimaryRegion'] else event['PrimaryRegion']
                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    response = rds.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id,
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id
                    )
                    return {'targetRegion': target_region, 'status': 'Failover initiated'}
              InputPayload:
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterId: '{{ GlobalClusterId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: TargetRegion
                Selector: $.targetRegion
                Type: String
          - name: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                import json

                def handler(event, context):
                    target_region = event['TargetRegion']
                    control_panel_arn = event['ControlPanelArn']
                    routing_control_arn = event['RoutingControlArn']
                    secret_arn = event['SecretArn']
                    global_cluster_id = event['GlobalClusterId']
                    arc = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=target_region)
                    current = arc.get_routing_control_state(RoutingControlArn=routing_control_arn)
                    new_state = 'OFF' if current['RoutingControlState'] == 'ON' else 'ON'
                    arc.update_routing_control_state(
                        RoutingControlArn=routing_control_arn,
                        RoutingControlState=new_state
                    )
                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=target_region)
                    clusters = rds.describe_db_clusters(
                        DBClusterIdentifier=global_cluster_id
                    )
                    writer_endpoint = clusters['DBClusters'][0]['Endpoint']
                    secrets = boto3.client('secretsmanager', region_name=target_region)
                    secrets.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=secret_arn,
                        SecretString=json.dumps({'writerEndpoint': writer_endpoint})
                    )
                    return {'newRoutingControlState': new_state, 'writerEndpoint': writer_endpoint}
              InputPayload:
                TargetRegion: '{{ PerformGlobalFailover.TargetRegion }}'
                ControlPanelArn: '{{ ControlPanelArn }}'
                RoutingControlArn: '{{ RoutingControlArn }}'
                SecretArn: '{{ SecretArn }}'
                GlobalClusterId: '{{ GlobalClusterId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.writerEndpoint
                Type: String
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
  TriggerFailoverLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
          SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
          PRIMARY_REGION: !Ref PrimaryRegion
          SECONDARY_REGION: !Ref SecondaryRegion
          GLOBAL_CLUSTER_ID: !Ref GlobalClusterId
          CONTROL_PANEL_ARN: !Ref ControlPanelArn
          ROUTING_CONTROL_ARN: !Ref RoutingControlArn
          SECRET_ARN: !Ref SecretArn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              document_name = os.environ['SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SSM Automation solution to enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT traffic) per CIS Benchmark, with direct and Change Manager-gated remediation documents.
Parameters:
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for the VPC Flow Logs CloudWatch log group.
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/vpc/flowlogs-cis
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for VPC Flow Logs.
Resources:
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: vpc-flow-logs-cis-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: vpc-flow-logs-automation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:ExecuteAutomation
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:CreateChangeRequest
                  - ssm:GetChangeRequest
                  - ssm:CreateChangeTemplate
                  - ssm:GetChangeTemplate
                  - ssm:ListChangeRequests
                  - ssm:ListChangeTemplates
                  - ssm:GetOpsItem
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
  EnableVPCFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentName: EnableVPCFlowLogsDirect
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs capturing REJECT traffic on a VPC (CIS control).
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationExecutionRole.Arn }}'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
            description: IAM role assumed by flow logs to write to CloudWatch Logs.
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            default: !Ref LogGroupName
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group destination.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.7
              Handler: enable_flow_logs
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def enable_flow_logs(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    vpc_id = events['VpcId']
                    role_arn = events['FlowLogsRoleArn']
                    log_group = events['LogGroupName']
                    existing = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[{'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]}]
                    )['FlowLogs']
                    active = [fl for fl in existing if fl['FlowLogStatus'] == 'ACTIVE']
                    if active:
                        return {'FlowLogId': active[0]['FlowLogId'], 'Message': 'Flow logs already active on VPC.'}
                    response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        ResourceType='VPC',
                        TrafficType='REJECT',
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=role_arn
                    )
                    fl = response['FlowLogIds'][0]
                    unsuccessful = response.get('Unsuccessful', [])
                    if unsuccessful:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to create flow log: %s' % unsuccessful)
                    return {'FlowLogId': fl, 'Message': 'VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) enabled.'}
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogId
                Selector: $.FlowLogId
                Type: String
              - Name: Message
                Selector: $.Message
                Type: String
        outputs:

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${LambdaFunctionName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Route53DelegationSetPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'route53:CreateReusableDelegationSet'
                  - 'route53:DeleteReusableDelegationSet'
                  - 'route53:GetReusableDelegationSet'
                  - 'route53:ListReusableDelegationSets'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn

  ReusableDelegationSetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          route53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              props = event.get('ResourceProperties', {})
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId')
              response_data = {}
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      caller_ref = props.get('CallerReference') or context.invoked_function_arn
                      resp = route53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=caller_ref)
                      ds = resp['DelegationSet']
                      physical_id = ds['Id']
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      resp = route53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                      ds = resp['DelegationSet']
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      route53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=physical_id)
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  else:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  name_servers = ds.get('NameServers', [])
                  response_data['DelegationSetId'] = ds['Id']
                  for i, ns in enumerate(name_servers[:4], start=1):
                      response_data['NameServer%d' % i] = ns
                  ips = ds.get('NameServersIps', [])
                  ipv4 = [ip for ip in ips if ':' not in ip]
                  ipv6 = [ip for ip in ips if ':' in ip]
                  for i, ip in enumerate(ipv4[:4], start=1):
                      response_data['NameServerIp%d' % i] = ip
                  for i, ip in enumerate(ipv6[:4], start=1):
                      response_data['NameServerIpv6%d' % i] = ip
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error: %s' % str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id)

  DelegationSet:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API asynchronously invoking Step Functions which responds back to the client

Parameters:
  ApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway WebSocket stage

Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: websocket-stepfunctions-api
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeResponderLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt ResponderFunction.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: websocket-responder-sm
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Wait 5 seconds then respond to WebSocket client",
            "StartAt": "WaitFiveSeconds",
            "States": {
              "WaitFiveSeconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "RespondToClient"
              },
              "RespondToClient": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${ResponderLambdaArn}",
                "Parameters": {
                  "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "message.$": "$.message"
                },
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - ResponderLambdaArn: !GetAtt ResponderFunction.Arn

  StepFunctionsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationSubtype: StepFunctions-StartExecution
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
      RequestParameters:
        StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
        Input: '{"connectionId": "$context.connectionId", "message": "$request.body"}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub integrations/${StepFunctionsIntegration}

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultRoute

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref ApiStageName

  ResponderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostToConnection
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:Invoke
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${ApiStageName}/POST/@connections/*

  ResponderFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: websocket-responder
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt ResponderRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          API_ENDPOINT: !Sub https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          client = boto3.client('apigatewaymanagementapi', endpoint_url=os.environ['API_ENDPOINT'])

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['connectionId']
              message = event['message']
              client.post_to_connection(
                  ConnectionId=connection_id,
                  Data=json.dumps({'message': message}).encode('utf-8')
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200}

  ResponderPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ResponderFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: states.amazonaws.com

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: Step Functions state machine ARN
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cost management stack - monthly budget with SNS notifications via SMS or email, encrypted with KMS.

Parameters:
  BudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    Description: Monthly budget limit in USD.
    MinValue: 1
  NotificationMethod:
    Type: String
    Default: sms
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Description: Notification method for budget alerts.
  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Description: Phone number (for SMS) or email address for notifications.
    AllowedPattern: '^.+$'
  CountryCode:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61'
    Description: Country code to prepend for SMS endpoints (ignored for email).

Conditions:
  IsSms: !Equals [!Ref NotificationMethod, 'sms']
  IsEmail: !Equals [!Ref NotificationMethod, 'email']

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for encrypting the billing SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsViaSNS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: billing-notifications
      KmsMasterKey: !Ref BillingTopicKey
      DisplayName: BillingNotifications

  BillingTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SmsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsSms
    Properties:
      Protocol: sms
      Endpoint: !Sub '${CountryCode}${NotificationEndpoint}'
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic

  EmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: IsEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic

  MonthlyBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: monthly-cost-budget
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref BudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: !If [IsSms, SMS, EMAIL]
              Address: !If [IsSms, !Sub '${CountryCode}${NotificationEndpoint}', !Ref NotificationEndpoint]
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: !If [IsSms, SMS, EMAIL]
              Address: !If [IsSms, !Sub '${CountryCode}${NotificationEndpoint}', !Ref NotificationEndpoint]

Outputs:
  TopicArn:
    Description: Billing notification SNS topic ARN
    Value: !Ref BillingNotificationTopic
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used for topic encryption
    Value: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn
  BudgetName:
    Description: Name of the created budget
    Value: monthly-cost-budget

Description: Cognito authentication infrastructure for the ontology lookup service with SSM parameter storage.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    Description: Application name used as the SSM parameter path prefix.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'ON'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      SoftwareTokenMfaConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AppName}-${AWS::AccountId}-auth'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub '${AppName}-resource'
      Name: !Sub '${AppName}-resource-server'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  AppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${AppName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${AppName}-resource/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  SSMClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AppClient
      Description: Cognito app client ID

  SSMClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/client-secret'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Cognito app client secret

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito user pool ID

  SSMScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/oauth-scope'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${AppName}-resource/read'
      Description: OAuth read scope

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AppName}/cognito/discovery-url'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'

      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless content moderation API using Amazon Rekognition
Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: invokeContentModerationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: '*'
  InvokeContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3
          import os

          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = ('.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png')
          MAX_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = 60

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {'error': 'Invalid JSON payload.'})

              url = body.get('url')
              if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
                  return _response(400, {'error': 'A "url" field is required in the JSON payload.'})

              lower_url = url.lower().split('?')[0]
              if not lower_url.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS):
                  return _response(400, {'error': 'Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, or png are allowed.'})

              try:
                  request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'ContentModerationLambda'})
                  with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                      image_bytes = response.read()
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return _response(404, {'error': 'Image not found at the provided URL.'})
                  return _response(400, {'error': f'Failed to fetch image: HTTP {e.code}'})
              except (urllib.error.URLError, ValueError):
                  return _response(400, {'error': 'Invalid or unreachable image URL.'})

              if len(image_bytes) > MAX_SIZE:
                  return _response(413, {'error': 'Image exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5MB.'})

              try:
                  result = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={'Bytes': image_bytes},

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Hourly EventBridge-scheduled Express Step Functions workflow that closes AWS
  Organization accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED and
  re-tags them as ACKNOWLEDGED, with full execution logging.

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/states/account-closure-workflow
      RetentionInDays: 365

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-sfn-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: account-closure-sfn-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrganizationsReadAndClose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: OrganizationsTagging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:TagResource
                  - organizations:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/organizations:account-closure:
                      - REQUESTED
                      - ACKNOWLEDGED
              - Sid: Logging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: LogGroupWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub "${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: account-closure-workflow
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionS3Location is not used; inline definition below via DefinitionString.
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Hourly closure of Organization accounts tagged REQUESTED",
            "StartAt": "ListAccounts",
            "States": {
              "ListAccounts": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
                "Parameters": {},
                "ResultSelector": {
                  "accounts.$": "$.Accounts",
                  "nextToken.$": "$.NextToken"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.page",
                "Retry": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                      "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                      "States.Timeout"
                    ],
                    "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                    "MaxAttempts": 5,
                    "BackoffRate": 2
                  }
                ],
                "Next": "ProcessPage"
              },
              "ProcessPage": {
                "Type": "Map",
                "ItemsPath": "$.page.accounts",
                "MaxConcurrency": 10,
                "ResultPath": null,
                "ItemProcessor": {
                  "ProcessorConfig": {
                    "Mode": "INLINE"
                  },
                  "StartAt": "GetAccountTags",
                  "States": {
                    "GetAccountTags": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.tags",
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "States.Timeout"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 5,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                          "ResultPath": "$.error",
                          "Next": "SkipAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "IsRequested"
                    },
                    "IsRequested": {
                      "Type": "Choice",
                      "Choices": [
                        {
                          "And": [
                            {
                              "Variable": "$.tags.Tags[*].Key",
                              "StringEquals": "organizations:account-closure"
                            },
                            {
                              "Variable": "$.tags.Tags[*].Value",
                              "StringEquals": "REQUESTED"
                            }
                          ],
                          "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Default": "SkipAccount"
                    },
                    "DescribeAccount": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": "$.account",
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "States.Timeout"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 5,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                          "ResultPath": "$.error",
                          "Next": "SkipAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "IsActive"
                    },
                    "IsActive": {
                      "Type": "Choice",
                      "Choices": [
                        {
                          "Variable": "$.account.Account.Status",
                          "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                          "Next": "CloseAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Default": "SkipAccount"
                    },
                    "CloseAccount": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                      },
                      "ResultPath": null,
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "States.Timeout",
                            "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 5,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                          "ResultPath": "$.error",
                          "Next": "SkipAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "TagAcknowledged"
                    },
                    "TagAcknowledged": {
                      "Type": "Task",
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                      "Parameters": {
                        "ResourceId.$": "$.Id",
                        "Tags": [
                          {
                            "Key": "organizations:account-closure",
                            "Value": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                          }
                        ]
                      },
                      "ResultPath": null,
                      "Retry": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": [
                            "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                            "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                            "States.Timeout"
                          ],
                          "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                          "MaxAttempts": 5,
                          "BackoffRate": 2
                        }
                      ],
                      "Catch": [
                        {
                          "ErrorEquals": ["States.ALL"],
                          "ResultPath": "$.error",
                          "Next": "SkipAccount"
                        }
                      ],
                      "Next": "AccountDone"
                    },
                    "SkipAccount": {
                      "Type": "Pass",
                      "Result": "Skipped",
                      "ResultPath": null,
                      "Next": "AccountDone"
                    },
                    "AccountDone": {
                      "Type": "Succeed"
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Next": "MorePages"
              },
              "MorePages": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "And": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.page.nextToken",
                        "IsPresent": true
                      },
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.page.nextToken",
                        "StringEquals": ""
                      },
                      {
                        "Not": {
                          "Variable": "$.page.nextToken",
                          "StringEquals": ""
                        }
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "GetNextPage"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "WorkflowDone"
              },
              "GetNextPage": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
                "Parameters": {
                  "NextToken.$": "$.page.nextToken"
                },
                "ResultSelector": {
                  "accounts.$": "$.Accounts",
                  "nextToken.$": "$.NextToken"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.page",
                "Retry": [
                  {
                    "ErrorEquals": [
                      "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                      "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                      "States.Timeout"
                    ],
                    "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                    "MaxAttempts": 5,
                    "BackoffRate": 2
                  }
                ],
                "Next": "ProcessPage"
              },
              "WorkflowDone": {
                "Type": "Succeed"
              }
            }
          }
        - {}

  EventBridgeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: account-closure-eventbridge-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-execution-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: !Sub "${AccountClosureStateMachine}:*"

  AccountClosureScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: account-closure-hourly-schedule
      Description: Triggers the account closure Step Functions workflow every hour
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachineTarget
          Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeRole.Arn
          RetryPolicy:
            MaximumRetryAttempts: 3
            MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 600

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the account closure state machine
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  StateMachineLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group for state machine execution logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the hourly EventBridge schedule rule
    Value: !GetAtt AccountClosureScheduleRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy Cognito user pool with Lambda triggers, Google IdP, Hosted UI, and app client
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: StudyBuddy
    Description: Project name used for resource naming
  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Description: Frontend domain name, e.g. https://app.studybuddy.com
    AllowedPattern: '^https?://.+$'
  CognitoDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: studybuddy-auth
    Description: Cognito-provided Hosted UI domain prefix (must be globally unique)
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
  GoogleClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
    Description: Google OAuth client ID (update the secret after deployment if needed)
  GoogleClientSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
    Description: Google OAuth client secret (update the secret after deployment if needed)

Resources:
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PreSignUpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pre-sign-up'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Auto-confirm and auto-verify users on sign-up
              event['response']['autoConfirmUser'] = True
              event['response']['autoVerifyEmail'] = True
              return event

  PostConfirmationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-post-confirmation'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Custom post-confirmation processing (e.g. welcome workflows)
              print('User confirmed:', event['userName'])
              return event

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-post-authentication'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              # Custom post-authentication processing (e.g. analytics, session setup)
              print('User authenticated:', event['userName'])
              return event

  PreSignUpPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PreSignUpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostConfirmationFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthenticationFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DependsOn:
      - PreSignUpPermission
      - PostConfirmationPermission
      - PostAuthenticationPermission
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OFF
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Welcome to StudyBuddy! Your verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'StudyBuddy email verification'

  GoogleSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/cognito/google-idp'
      Description: Google OAuth credentials for the StudyBuddy Cognito identity provider
      SecretString: !Sub
        - '{"client_id":"${ClientId}","client_secret":"${ClientSecret}"}'
        - ClientId: !Ref GoogleClientId
          ClientSecret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret

  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref GoogleClientId
        client_secret: !Ref GoogleClientSecret
        authorize_scopes: 'profile email openid'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Ref CognitoDomainPrefix

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-frontend-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref FrontendDomain
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref FrontendDomain
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ReadAttributes:
        - email
        - email_verified
        - given_name
        - family_name
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - given_name
        - family_name

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: StudyBuddy Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Frontend app client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito Hosted UI domain

  GoogleIdpSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding Google IdP credentials
    Value: !Ref GoogleSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Security Hub automation rules to suppress reviewed and accepted findings

Parameters:
  DesignatedSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Account ID of the designated sub-account for scoped CIS suppressions
  EbsAccountAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Account ID for EBS default-encryption suppression
  AutomationAccount1:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: First infrequent automation account for credential suppressions
  AutomationAccount2:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"
    Description: Second infrequent automation account for credential suppressions
  ExcludedUserName1:
    Type: String
    Default: breakglass-admin
    Description: Human user excluded from IAM finding suppression
  ExcludedUserName2:
    Type: String
    Default: security-auditor
    Description: Second human user excluded from IAM finding suppression
  PublicBucketNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: "public-assets-example,static-site-content-example"
    Description: Comma-separated list of intentionally public S3 bucket names
  GuardDutyBedrockFindingType:
    Type: String
    Default: TTPs/DefenseEvasion/IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior
    Description: GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity

Resources:
  IamFindingsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress reviewed IAM-related findings across the organization except named human users
      RuleName: OrgWideIamFindingsSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            ResourceType:
              StringEquals:
                - AwsIamUser
                - AwsIamRole
                - AwsIamAccessKey
            ResourceId:
              NotStringContains:
                - !Ref ExcludedUserName1
                - !Ref ExcludedUserName2
          Note:
            Text: IAM findings reviewed and accepted as expected or non-actionable. Excludes break-glass and audit users.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  SubAccountCisSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress specific CIS benchmark findings scoped to the designated sub-account
      RuleName: SubAccountCisSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            AwsAccountId:
              StringEquals:
                - !Ref DesignatedSubAccountId
            GeneratorId:
              StringContains:
                - securityhub/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark
                - securityhub/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v1.4.0
                - securityhub/cis-aws-foundations-benchmark/v3.0.0
          Note:
            Text: CIS benchmark findings for the designated sub-account reviewed and accepted as expected.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  OrgWideCisFsbpSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress reviewed CIS and FSBP findings organization-wide including bastion security groups, S3 public/HTTP settings, and Config coverage
      RuleName: OrgWideCisFsbpSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            ComplianceSecurityControlId:
              StringContains:
                - EC2.18
                - EC2.19
                - EC2.20
                - EC2.21
                - EC2.22
                - S3.8
                - S3.9
                - Config.1
                - CIS
          Note:
            Text: Organization-wide suppression of reviewed CIS and FSBP findings including security group admin ports for bastion/testing, S3 public and HTTP access settings, and AWS Config regional coverage.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  PublicBucketsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public buckets
      RuleName: KnownPublicBucketsSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            ResourceId:
              StringContains: !Ref PublicBucketNames
            ResourceType:
              StringEquals:
                - AwsS3Bucket
          Note:
            Text: Public-access findings for known intentionally public buckets reviewed and accepted.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  EbsDefaultEncryptionSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress EBS default-encryption finding for one specific account
      RuleName: EbsDefaultEncryptionSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            AwsAccountId:
              StringEquals:
                - !Ref EbsAccountAccountId
            ComplianceSecurityControlId:
              StringEquals:
                - EC2.1
            ResourceType:
              StringEquals:
                - AwsEc2Region
          Note:
            Text: EBS default-encryption finding for this account reviewed and accepted as expected.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  InfrequentAutomationCredentialsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two infrequent automation accounts
      RuleName: InfrequentAutomationCredentialsSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            AwsAccountId:
              StringEquals:
                - !Ref AutomationAccount1
                - !Ref AutomationAccount2
            ComplianceSecurityControlId:
              StringEquals:
                - IAM.7
                - IAM.21
                - IAM.23
          Note:
            Text: Unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for infrequent automation accounts reviewed and accepted.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

  GuardDutyBedrockSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      Description: Suppress one specific GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity
      RuleName: GuardDutyBedrockSuppression
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      Rules:
        - Criteria:
            RecordState:
              StringEquals:
                - ACTIVE
            FindingType:
              StringEquals:
                - !Ref GuardDutyBedrockFindingType
          Note:
            Text: GuardDuty finding type related to expected cross-account Bedrock API activity reviewed and accepted.
            UpdatedBy: security-hub-automation-cfn
          Workflow:
            Status: SUPPRESSED

Outputs:
  IamFindingsSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the org-wide IAM findings suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt IamFindingsSuppressionRule.RuleArn
  SubAccountCisSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the sub-account CIS suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt SubAccountCisSuppressionRule.RuleArn
  OrgWideCisFsbpSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the org-wide CIS/FSBP suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt OrgWideCisFsbpSuppressionRule.RuleArn
  PublicBucketsSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the known public buckets suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt PublicBucketsSuppressionRule.RuleArn
  EbsDefaultEncryptionSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EBS default-encryption suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt EbsDefaultEncryptionSuppressionRule.RuleArn
  InfrequentAutomationCredentialsSuppressionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrequent automation credentials suppression rule
    Value: !GetAtt InfrequentAutomationCredentialsSuppressionRule.RuleArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: SAM template provisioning the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function for testing a Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, with supporting IAM roles and log group.

Parameters:
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket the tool is allowed to perform object operations on.
    Default: ''
  FunctionTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Description: Timeout in seconds for the Lambda function.
    Default: 300
  FunctionMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Description: Memory allocation (MB) for the Lambda function.
    Default: 1024

Conditions:
  HasS3BucketName:
    !Not [!Equals [!Ref S3BucketName, '']]

Resources:
  BacMcpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  BacMcpToolRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-mcp-tool-execution-role
      Description: Execution role for the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeFoundationModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CostExplorerAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetReservationCoverage
                  - ce:GetReservationPurchaseRecommendation
                  - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansPurchaseRecommendation
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
                  - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilizationDetails
                  - ce:GetTags
                  - ce:GetUsageReport
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ObjectOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !If
                  - HasS3BucketName
                  - !Sub
                    - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${Bucket}'
                    - Bucket: !Ref S3BucketName
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: S3BucketListAll
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt BacMcpToolLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: XRayAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: MCP tool Lambda for testing a Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent.
      Runtime: python3.12
      CodeUri: ./src
      Handler: app.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref FunctionMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref FunctionTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt BacMcpToolRole.Arn
      Tracing: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref BacMcpToolLogGroup
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
          S3_BUCKET_NAME: !Ref S3BucketName

  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-agentcore-gateway-role
      Description: Role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway service to invoke MCP tool Lambda functions in this account.
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-agentcore-gateway-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
              - Sid: ManageAgentCoreResources
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:DeleteGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListGateways
                  - bedrock-agentcore:UpdateGateway
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:DeleteGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetGatewayTarget
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListGatewayTargets
                  - bedrock-agentcore:UpdateGatewayTarget
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: PassIamRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt BacMcpToolRole.Arn
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !If
                  - HasS3BucketName
                  - !Sub
                    - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${Bucket}'
                    - Bucket: !Ref S3BucketName
                  - 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool*'

Outputs:
  FunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
  FunctionName:
    Description: Name of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref BacMcpToolFunction
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to assume.
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group for the function.
    Value: !Ref BacMcpToolLogGroup
