AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS-hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk, built daily, scanned, distributed cross-account, with 6-month lifecycle deletion.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID (e.g., o-xxxxxxxxxx) to share launch permissions with.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy dev environment AWS account ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dummy prod environment AWS account ID.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  ParentImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: x.x.x
    Description: Version of the CIS hardened parent image.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-role-${AWS::StackName}'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-profile-${AWS::StackName}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  BeanstalkPrepComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'eb-prep-component-${AWS::StackName}'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Pre-configures the AMI for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility.
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkPrep
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y ruby wget
                    - dnf clean all
              - name: ConfigureCloudInit
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - mkdir -p /opt/aws
                    - ln -sfn /opt/elasticbeanstalk /opt/aws/elasticbeanstalk || true
                    - echo "Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration complete" > /etc/eb-prep-complete
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'eb-prep-component-${AWS::StackName}'

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-eb-recipe-${AWS::StackName}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Recipe based on CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM image with EB pre-configuration.
      ParentImage: !Sub 'cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/${ParentImageVersion}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt BeanstalkPrepComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-eb-recipe-${AWS::StackName}'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-infra-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for the CIS hardened AL2023 ARM image pipeline.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t4g.small
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-infra-${AWS::StackName}'

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-dist-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Distribute AMI to current region with launch permissions for org, dev and prod accounts.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-eb-{{imagebuilder:buildDate}}-${AWS::StackName}'
            Description: CIS L1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM AMI pre-configured for Elastic Beanstalk.
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
          DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-dist-${AWS::StackName}'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-pipeline-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Daily pipeline building CIS hardened AL2023 ARM AMI with EB pre-configuration.
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-pipeline-${AWS::StackName}'

  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-lifecycle-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecycleImageDeletion
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'imagebuilder-lifecycle-role-${AWS::StackName}'

  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-lifecycle-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Delete images automatically after 6 months.
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Name
            Version: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            - Type: DELETE
              IncludeResources: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
          ResourceStatus: ALL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub 'cis-al2023-arm-lifecycle-${AWS::StackName}'

Outputs:
  PipelineName:
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration.
    Value: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the image lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageLifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP server with API Gateway, Lambda and Cognito authentication

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage for the API
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito App Client

Resources:
  MathsMcpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Maths MCP placeholder handler'})
              }

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  AppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  ApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-authorizer'
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  RootResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGateway.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ResourceId: !Ref RootResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ResourceId: !Ref RootResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: '''Content-Type,Authorization'''
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: '''POST,OPTIONS'''
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '''*'''
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  HealthCheckMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiGateway.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpLambda.Arn}/invocations'

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiGateway}/*/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
      - HealthCheckMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGateway
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the API
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiGateway}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  AppClientId:
    Description: Cognito App Client ID
    Value: !Ref AppClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Creates an Amazon Verified Permissions policy store with a Cedar schema for a Bookstore application, static Cedar policies, and publishes the policy store ID to SSM Parameter Store.
Parameters:
  PolicyStoreName:
    Type: String
    Default: BookstorePolicyStore
    Description: Name of the Verified Permissions policy store.
  ValidationMode:
    Type: String
    Default: STRICT
    AllowedValues:
      - OFF
      - STRICT
    Description: Schema validation mode for the policy store.
Resources:
  BookstorePolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    Properties:
      Description: Policy store for the Bookstore application with Cedar-based access control
      PolicyStoreName: !Ref PolicyStoreName
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: !Ref ValidationMode
      Schema:
        CedarJson: >-
          {"Bookstore":{"entityTypes":{"Book":{"shape":{"attributes":{"owner":{"attributeReferences":{"User":{}}},"type":"Record"}}},"Role":{},"User":{"memberOfTypes":["Role"],"shape":{"attributes":{"yearsAsMember":{"type":"Long"}}}}},"actions":{"View":{"appliesTo":{"principalTypes":["User"],"resourceTypes":["Book"],"context":{"attributes":{"region":{"type":"String"}},"type":"Record"}}},"ViewWithPremiumOffers":{"appliesTo":{"principalTypes":["User"],"resourceTypes":["Book"],"context":{"attributes":{"region":{"type":"String"}},"type":"Record"}}}}}}
  AdminRoleViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in the Admin role to view any book
          Statement: 'permit(principal in Bookstore::Role::"Admin", action == [Bookstore::Action::"View"], resource);'
  BlockNamedAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid a specific named administrator from viewing books, overriding the general admin permission
          Statement: 'forbid(principal == Bookstore::User::"blocked-admin", action == [Bookstore::Action::"View"], resource);'
  PublisherOwnBookViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in the Publisher role to view only books they own
          Statement: 'permit(principal in Bookstore::Role::"Publisher", action == [Bookstore::Action::"View"], resource) when { resource.owner == principal };'
  NamedUserNamedBookViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit a specific named user to view a specific named book
          Statement: 'permit(principal == Bookstore::User::"alice", action == [Bookstore::Action::"View"], resource == Bookstore::Book::"book-123");'
  CustomerPremiumOffersPermitPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Permit users in the Customer role to view premium offers once they have been members for two years or more
          Statement: 'permit(principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer", action == [Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"], resource) when { principal.yearsAsMember >= 2 };'
  CustomerPremiumOffersForbidPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid customers with less than two years of membership from viewing premium offers
          Statement: 'forbid(principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer", action == [Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"], resource) when { principal.yearsAsMember < 2 };'
  NonUSRegionForbidPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DependsOn: BookstorePolicyStore
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: Forbid View and ViewWithPremiumOffers actions entirely when the request context region is not the United States
          Statement: 'forbid(principal, action == [Bookstore::Action::"View", Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"], resource) when { context.region != "US" };'
  PolicyStoreIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /bookstore/verified-permissions/policy-store-id
      Description: Policy store ID of the Bookstore Verified Permissions policy store
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
Outputs:
  PolicyStoreId:
    Description: The ID of the Verified Permissions policy store
    Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
  PolicyStoreIdParameterName:
    Description: SSM Parameter name holding the policy store ID
    Value: !Ref PolicyStoreIdParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Fargate ECS task definition with ECR image URI and IAM roles

Parameters:
  RepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: sample-container-repository
    Description: Name of the ECR repository containing the container image
  ImageTag:
    Type: String
    Default: v1.0.0
    Description: Immutable tag of the container image

Resources:
  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TaskRoleMinimalPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  ECSExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  FargateTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fargate-task'
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: sample-container
          Image: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${RepositoryName}:${ImageTag}'
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 8080
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref AwsLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  AwsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}-fargate-task'
      RetentionInDays: 30

Outputs:
  ImageUri:
    Description: Full URI of the container image in ECR
    Value: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}.dkr.ecr.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${RepositoryName}:${ImageTag}'
  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Fargate task definition
    Value: !Ref FargateTaskDefinition
  TaskRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task role
    Value: !GetAtt ECSTaskRole.Arn
  ExecutionRoleArn:

    Type: String

    Description: Name of the API key.

              - Effect: Allow

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:

      Description: API for sending emails via SES
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: EmailModel
      Schema:
        $schema: http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#
        title: EmailSchema
        type: object
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          from:
            type: string
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          subject:
            type: string

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Name: email-request-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId

    Properties:

      ResourceId: !Ref EmailResource

        application/json: !Ref EmailModel

        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST

              "Version": "2010-12-01",

          StageName: !Ref StageName

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    Properties:
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref RestApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH
      Throttle:
        RateLimit: 500
        BurstLimit: 1000
      UsagePlanName: email-api-usage-plan

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiUrl:
    Description: URL of the API endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}/email
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: API key ID
    Value: !Ref ApiKey

Description: Step Functions calculator demo with a Node.js 20.x Lambda and Choice state routing
Resources:
  CalculatorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/Calculator
      RetentionInDays: 3

  CalculatorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: Calculator-LambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaLoggingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  CalculatorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: Calculator
      Runtime: nodejs20.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt CalculatorRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          exports.handler = async (event) => {
            const { operator, operands } = event;
            if (!Array.isArray(operands) || operands.length < 2) {
              throw new Error('Operands must be an array with at least two numbers');
            }
            let result;
            switch (operator) {
              case 'add':
                result = operands.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
                break;
              case 'subtract':
                result = operands.reduce((a, b) => a - b);
                break;
              case 'multiply':
                result = operands.reduce((a, b) => a * b, 1);
                break;
              case 'divide':
                result = operands.reduce((a, b) => a / b);
                break;
              default:
                throw new Error(`Unsupported operator: ${operator}`);
            }
            return { operator, operands, result };
          };

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: Calculator-StateMachineRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeCalculatorPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn

  CalculatorStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: Calculator-StateMachine
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Calculator demo state machine",
            "StartAt": "RouteOperation",
            "States": {
              "RouteOperation": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  { "Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "add", "Next": "InvokeAdd" },
                  { "Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "subtract", "Next": "InvokeSubtract" },
                  { "Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "multiply", "Next": "InvokeMultiply" },
                  { "Variable": "$.operator", "StringEquals": "divide", "Next": "InvokeDivide" }
                ],
                "Default": "FailUnknownOperator"
              },
              "InvokeAdd": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${LambdaArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "End": true
              },
              "InvokeSubtract": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${LambdaArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "End": true
              },
              "InvokeMultiply": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${LambdaArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "End": true
              },
              "InvokeDivide": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${LambdaArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$",
                "End": true
              },
              "FailUnknownOperator": {
                "Type": "Fail",
                "Error": "UnknownOperator",
                "Cause": "The operator provided is not supported. Supported operators are add, subtract, multiply, and divide."
              }
            }
          }
        - LambdaArn: !GetAtt CalculatorFunction.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:

    Description: ARN of the Calculator Lambda function

Description: SageMaker notebook instance for RAPIDS AI development with lifecycle configuration

Resources:
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rapidsai-sagemaker-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: !Sub |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              # Install RAPIDS AI conda environment
              conda create -y -n rapids-ai -c conda-forge -c rapidsai -c nvidia python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 rapids
              # Register the RAPIDS kernel with Jupyter
              source activate rapids-ai
              pip install ipykernel
              python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids-ai --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3)"
              EOF
      OnStart:
        - Content:
            Fn::Base64: !Sub |
              #!/bin/bash
              set -e
              sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOF'
              # Ensure the RAPIDS kernel is registered on every start
              if ! jupyter kernelspec list | grep -q rapids-ai; then
                source activate rapids-ai
                python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids-ai --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3)"
              fi
              EOF

  RapidsNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: !GetAtt RapidsLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName
      DefaultRepository:
        RepositoryUrl: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookInstance
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookInstance.NotebookInstanceArn
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker execution role
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  SLO monitoring dashboard and CloudWatch alarms for an event-driven pipeline
  pattern based on FSx for ONTAP. Deploys only when EnableMonitoring is true.
  Region defaults to us-east-1 at deployment time.

Parameters:
  EnableMonitoring:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'
    Description: Set to true to deploy the dashboard and alarms.
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    Description: Project prefix used for resource naming.
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    Description: Metric namespace for the pipeline SLO metrics.
  CanaryNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    Description: Metric namespace for synthetic canary metrics.
  AlarmNotificationArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SNS topic ARN to receive alarm notifications.
  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency threshold in seconds.
  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    Description: Average processing success rate threshold in percent.
  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time threshold in seconds.
  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Maximum replay completion time threshold in seconds.

Conditions:
  MonitoringEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableMonitoring, 'true']
  AlarmNotificationProvided: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn, '']]

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-EventIngestionLatency'
      AlarmDescription: P99 event ingestion latency exceeds threshold.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      Statistic: p99
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-ProcessingSuccessRate'
      AlarmDescription: Average processing success rate below threshold.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-FPolicyReconnectTime'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time exceeds threshold.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-ReplayCompletionTime'
      AlarmDescription: Maximum replay completion time exceeds threshold.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      OKActions: !If [AlarmNotificationProvided, [!Ref AlarmNotificationArn], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']

  SloDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "p99",
                  "period": 300,
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      {"label": "SLO Threshold", "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold}}
                    ]
                  },
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 0, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Average",
                  "period": 300,
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      {"label": "SLO Threshold", "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold}}
                    ]
                  },
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 6, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time (Maximum)",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Maximum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      {"label": "SLO Threshold", "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold}}
                    ]
                  },
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 6, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Replay Completion Time (Maximum)",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Maximum",
                  "period": 300,
                  "annotations": {
                    "horizontal": [
                      {"label": "SLO Threshold", "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold}}
                    ]
                  },
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 12, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Canary - S3AP List Latency",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Average",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${CanaryNamespace}", "S3APListLatency"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 12, "y": 12, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Canary - S3AP Get Latency",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Average",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${CanaryNamespace}", "S3APGetLatency"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "metric",
                "x": 0, "y": 18, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "Canary - ONTAP Health Check",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "stat": "Average",
                  "period": 300,
                  "metrics": [
                    ["${CanaryNamespace}", "ONTAPHealthCheck"]
                  ]
                }
              },
              {
                "type": "alarm",
                "x": 12, "y": 18, "width": 12, "height": 6,
                "properties": {
                  "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                  "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                  "alarms": [
                    "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm}",
                    "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm}",
                    "${FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm}",
                    "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm}"
                  ]
                }
              }
            ]
          }
        - EventIngestionLatencyThreshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
          ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold
          FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold
          ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold
          MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          CanaryNamespace: !Ref CanaryNamespace
          EventIngestionLatencyAlarm: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyAlarm
          ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm
          FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm
          ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm
    DependsOn:
      - EventIngestionLatencyAlarm
      - ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm
      - FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm
      - ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
  DashboardUrl:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyAlarm
  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm
  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm
  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Condition: MonitoringEnabled
    Value: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm

Description: Cognito User Pool for testing JWT authentication with AgentCore Gateway and MCP server

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed callback URLs
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: http://localhost:3000
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed logout URLs

    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-test-auth

        - email

        - email

        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

        AdvancedSecurityMode: OFF
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

      Schema:
        - Name: email

          Mutable: true

        - api/mcp

      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AWS Backup infrastructure with tag-based daily, weekly, and monthly backup plans, encrypted vaults, KMS key with rotation, IAM service role, and Service Catalog TagOptions.

Resources:
  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for AWS Backup vaults encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  BackupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/aws-backup-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKmsKey

  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-backup-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores'

  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan'
        BackupPlanRuleList:
          - RuleName: DailyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14

  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan'
        BackupPlanRuleList:
          - RuleName: WeeklyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56

  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan'
        BackupPlanRuleList:
          - RuleName: MonthlyRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 1 * ? *)
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365

  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Selection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      SelectionName: DailyTagSelection
      IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
      Resources:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:instance/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds:*:*:db:*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:*:*:table/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:efs:*:*:file-system/*'
      ListOfTags:
        - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
          ConditionKey: backup
          ConditionValue: daily

  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Selection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      SelectionName: WeeklyTagSelection
      IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
      Resources:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:instance/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds:*:*:db:*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:*:*:table/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:efs:*:*:file-system/*'
      ListOfTags:
        - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
          ConditionKey: backup
          ConditionValue: weekly

  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::Selection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      SelectionName: MonthlyTagSelection
      IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
      Resources:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:instance/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:rds:*:*:db:*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:*:*:table/*'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:efs:*:*:file-system/*'
      ListOfTags:
        - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
          ConditionKey: backup
          ConditionValue: monthly

  DailyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily

  WeeklyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly

  MonthlyTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for vault encryption
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
  DailyVaultName:
    Description: Daily backup vault name
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupVault
  WeeklyVaultName:
    Description: Weekly backup vault name
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
  MonthlyVaultName:
    Description: Monthly backup vault name
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Daily backup plan ID
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Weekly backup plan ID
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Monthly backup plan ID
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN used by AWS Backup
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture (SQS -> Lambda -> DynamoDB, DynamoDB Streams -> Lambda -> SNS, API Gateway -> SQS)

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Environment name used to construct resource names

Resources:
  LambdaSQSToDynamoDBPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-lambda-sqs-to-dynamodb-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows Lambda to read from SQS queue and write to DynamoDB orders table
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadFromSQS
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'
          - Sid: WriteToDynamoDB

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudFormation template creating Athena named queries for AppStream 2.0 usage analysis

Parameters:
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream-usage
    Description: The Athena database containing the AppStream 2.0 usage data
  WorkGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: primary
    Description: The Athena workgroup to associate the named queries with

Resources:
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-AvgSessionLengthPerStack-CurrentMonth
      Description: Average session length per stack for the current month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               AVG(session_duration) AS avg_session_length_seconds
        FROM appstream_sessions
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_seconds DESC

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-AvgSessionLengthPerStack-PreviousMonth
      Description: Average session length per stack for the previous month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               AVG(session_duration) AS avg_session_length_seconds
        FROM appstream_sessions
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date - interval '1' month) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date - interval '1' month) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_seconds DESC

  DailySessionCountsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-DailySessionCounts-CurrentMonth
      Description: Daily session counts for the current month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT date_trunc('day', start_time) AS session_date,
               COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count
        FROM appstream_sessions
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY date_trunc('day', start_time)
        ORDER BY session_date

  SessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-SessionDetails-CurrentMonth
      Description: All session details for the current month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT session_id,
               user_id,
               stack_name,
               applications,
               start_time,
               end_time,
               session_duration
        FROM appstream_sessions
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        ORDER BY start_time DESC

  StreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-StreamingHoursPerUser-CurrentMonth
      Description: Streaming hours per user for the current month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               ROUND(SUM(session_duration) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM appstream_sessions
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY user_id
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream-UniqueUsersPerApplication-CurrentMonth
      Description: Unique users per application for the current month
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      WorkGroup: !Ref WorkGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT application,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_users
        FROM appstream_sessions
        CROSS JOIN UNNEST(split(applications, ',')) AS t(application)
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY application
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

Outputs:
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for average session length per stack (current month)
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQuery
  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for average session length per stack (previous month)
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQuery
  DailySessionCountsQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for daily session counts
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountsQuery
  SessionDetailsQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for session details
    Value: !Ref SessionDetailsQuery
  StreamingHoursPerUserQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for streaming hours per user
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserQuery
  UniqueUsersPerApplicationQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for unique users per application
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationQuery

Description: QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment with Glue ETL, Firehose and CloudWatch Metric Streams.

    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that will hold the Glue ETL scripts.
  QuickSightNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: default
    Description: QuickSight namespace used by the ETL scripts.

    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'

        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256

  AdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          scripts = {
              "assets_access.py": "import sys\nfrom awsglue.transforms import *\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nfrom pyspark.context import SparkContext\nfrom awsglue.context import GlueContext\nfrom awsglue.job import Job\nargs = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME','OUTPUT_BUCKET','NAMESPACE'])\nsc = SparkContext()\nglueContext = GlueContext(sc)\njob = Job(glueContext)\njob.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n# Extract QuickSight assets access metadata and write to S3\njob.commit()\n",
              "dataset_metadata.py": "import sys\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nfrom awsglue.context import GlueContext\nfrom pyspark.context import SparkContext\nfrom awsglue.job import Job\nargs = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME','OUTPUT_BUCKET','NAMESPACE'])\nsc = SparkContext()\nglueContext = GlueContext(sc)\njob = Job(glueContext)\njob.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n# Extract QuickSight dataset properties\njob.commit()\n",
              "folder_assets.py": "import sys\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nfrom awsglue.context import GlueContext\nfrom pyspark.context import SparkContext\nfrom awsglue.job import Job\nargs = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME','OUTPUT_BUCKET','NAMESPACE'])\nsc = SparkContext()\nglueContext = GlueContext(sc)\njob = Job(glueContext)\njob.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n# Extract QuickSight folder asset relationships\njob.commit()\n",
              "q_metadata.py": "import sys\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nfrom awsglue.context import GlueContext\nfrom pyspark.context import SparkContext\nfrom awsglue.job import Job\nargs = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME','OUTPUT_BUCKET','NAMESPACE'])\nsc = SparkContext()\nglueContext = GlueContext(sc)\njob = Job(glueContext)\njob.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n# Extract QuickSight Q search index and action metrics\njob.commit()\n",
              "datasource_properties.py": "import sys\nfrom awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions\nfrom awsglue.context import GlueContext\nfrom pyspark.context import SparkContext\nfrom awsglue.job import Job\nargs = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME','OUTPUT_BUCKET','NAMESPACE'])\nsc = SparkContext()\nglueContext = GlueContext(sc)\njob = Job(glueContext)\njob.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)\n# Extract QuickSight datasource properties\njob.commit()\n"
          }
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['ScriptBucket']
                      for name, content in scripts.items():
                          s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key='scripts/' + name, Body=content.encode('utf-8'))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for Puppet Quick Start deployment with Route53 private hosted zone.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second availability zone.
  PuppetIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    Description: IP address for puppet.example.com.
  LinuxAgentIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    Description: IP address for linuxagent.example.com.
  WindowsAgentIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    Description: IP address for windowsagent.example.com.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartVPC

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - '1'
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicSubnet

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetQuickStartPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PuppetHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com.
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref VPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for Puppet Quick Start.

  PuppetRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '60'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetIpAddress

  LinuxAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '60'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIpAddress

  WindowsAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com.
      Type: A
      TTL: '60'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIpAddress

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the public subnet.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with Cloud Map service discovery and auto scaling

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: myservice
    Description: Name of the ECS service and Cloud Map service
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port the container listens on
  Cpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units for the task
  Memory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory (MiB) for the task
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of tasks
  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN the containers can assume

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow container-to-container communication within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: -1
          FromPort: -1
          ToPort: -1
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-sg'

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ImageUrl
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.internal'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 10
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 3

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          Port: !Ref ContainerPort

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      RoleARN: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForApplicationAutoScalingECSService'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 2

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when average CPU is at or above 70 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 70
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when average CPU is at or below 20 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Threshold: 20
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

Conditions:
  HasTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, '']]

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: ECS Service name
    Value: !Ref ECSService
  ServiceDiscoveryDNS:
    Description: DNS name for service discovery (SRV record)
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal'
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hybrid interconnect network backbone with OCI VPN, transit gateway, and encrypted VPC flow logs.

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  InternalHttpsCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  OciTransitCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.96.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  OciVpnPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
  CreateOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals [!Ref CreateOciVpn, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-subnet-az1

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-rt

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Hybrid interconnect transit gateway
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-tgw

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: hybrid-backbone-tgw-attachment

  TransitGatewayOciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !GetAtt TransitGateway.DefaultRouteTableId
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciTransitCidr
      Blackhole: false

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS only inbound from internal CIDR, HTTPS only outbound to OCI backbone
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443

    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: IPsec.1
      BgpAsn: 65000
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPublicIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: oci-customer-gateway

  VpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Type: IPsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: oci-vpn-connection

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow log encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
            Action:

              - kms:DescribeKey
