            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/*

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flowlogs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  VpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Value: !Ref VpnConnection
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
  KmsKeyId:
    Value: !Ref KmsKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline with S3, IAM role, Glue jobs and scheduled triggers

Parameters:
  BucketPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin-dataprep
    Description: Prefix for the S3 bucket name (account ID will be appended)
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/qs-admin
    Description: S3 prefix where Glue job scripts are stored
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
    Description: Schedule expression for the Glue triggers (every 3 hours)

Resources:
  DataPrepBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  DataPrepRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'qs-admin-dataprep-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: qs-admin-dataprep-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*glue*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*cloudformation*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: quicksight:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DataPrepBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DataPrepBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - logs:*
                Resource: '*'

  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-group-membership-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/group_membership.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-object-access-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/object_access.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-assets-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_assets.py'
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
      MaxCapacity: 0.0625

  FolderLookupJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-lookup-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_lookup.py'
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 1

  FolderPathJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-path-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Role: !GetAtt DataPrepRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_path.py'
        PythonVersion: '3'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 1

  GroupMembershipTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-group-membership-trigger-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GroupMembershipJob

  ObjectAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-object-access-trigger-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref ObjectAccessJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-assets-trigger-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  FolderLookupTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-lookup-trigger-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderLookupJob

  FolderPathTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'qs-admin-folder-path-trigger-${AWS::AccountId}'
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderPathJob

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path of the group membership script
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/group_membership.py'
  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path of the object access script
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/object_access.py'
  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path of the folder assets script
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_assets.py'
  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path of the folder lookup script
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_lookup.py'
  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path of the folder path script
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/folder_path.py'
  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: CloudTrail log table name for downstream use
    Value: !Sub 'qs_admin_cloudtrail_log_${AWS::AccountId}'
  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location of CloudTrail logs for downstream use
    Value: !Sub 's3://${DataPrepBucket.BucketName}/cloudtrail-logs/'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom AMIs with Chef recipe component, daily schedule, lifecycle policy and custom workflow.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-ami-pipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder image pipeline.
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe-component
    Description: Name of the Chef recipe component.
  RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-ami-recipe
    Description: Name of the image recipe.
  InfraConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-ami-infra-config
    Description: Name of the infrastructure configuration.
  DistributionConfigName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-ami-distribution-config
    Description: Name of the distribution configuration.
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Target region for AMI distribution.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.large
    Description: Instance type used for image builds.
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 day)
    Description: Schedule expression for the pipeline.
  VolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Root volume size in GiB.
  VolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io1
      - io2
    Description: Root volume type.
  DeprecateAfterDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Deprecate AMIs older than this many days.
  ChefRecipeBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe.
  ChefRecipeKey:
    Type: String
    Default: recipes/default.rb
    Description: S3 key of the Chef recipe.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ChefRecipeAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket

      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:

      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true

  Image:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Image
    Properties:
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn

        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true

  BuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow

      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-build-workflow'
      Version: '1.0.0'

          Action:
            Name: ExecuteBash
            Inputs:

    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:

      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeAmisInOtherAccounts: false
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref DeprecateAfterDays
            Unit: DAYS
          ExclusionRules:
            Amis:
              IsPublic: false
              Tags:
                - Key: KeepForever
                  Value: 'true'

  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lifecycle-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecycleDeprecate
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeImageAttribute

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PII classification scanner for S3 Access Point content using Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities, storing results in DynamoDB with optional SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan (e.g. arn:aws:s3:us-east-1:123456789012:accesspoint/my-ap).
  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SNS topic ARN for scan notifications.
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: VPC ID if the access point has VPC network origin. Leave empty for internet-origin access points.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs for the Lambda when VpcId is supplied.
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group ID for the Lambda when VpcId is supplied.
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route table IDs for the S3 Gateway endpoint when VpcId is supplied.
  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Set to false if the target VPC already has S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend, or SNS endpoints.
  LambdaMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900
  LanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues: [en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ar, hi, ja, ko, zh, zh-TW]
  MaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  HasSns: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SnsTopicArn, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition HasVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pii-reports'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: objectKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: scanTimestamp
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: objectKey
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: scanTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScannerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Ref AccessPointArn
                  - !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3control:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Ref AccessPointArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - !If
                - HasSns
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref SnsTopicArn
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemory
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          REPORT_TABLE: !Ref ReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SnsTopicArn
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref LanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFiles
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, json, os, math

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          s3control = boto3.client('s3control')
          comprehend = boto3.client('comprehend')
          ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['REPORT_TABLE'])
          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          AP_ARN = os.environ['ACCESS_POINT_ARN']
          LANG = os.environ['LANGUAGE_CODE']
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ['MAX_FILES'])
          SNS_ARN = os.environ.get('SNS_TOPIC_ARN', '')
          CHUNK_SIZE = 490000  # bytes per Comprehend call (below 100KB text / safe margin)
          SAMPLE_RATE = 1      # scan every Nth object (sampling control)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              account = AP_ARN.split(':')[4]
              ap_name = AP_ARN.split('/')[-1]
              ap = s3control.get_access_point(AccountId=account, Name=ap_name)
              if ap.get('NetworkOrigin') == 'VPC' and not os.environ.get('AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_URL'):
                  pass  # running inside the VPC is expected for VPC-origin access points
              scanned = 0
              findings = 0
              paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_objects_v2')
              for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=AP_ARN):
                  for obj in page.get('Contents', []):
                      if scanned >= MAX_FILES:
                          break
                      if obj['Size'] == 0 or scanned % SAMPLE_RATE != 0:
                          scanned += 1
                          continue
                      key = obj['Key']
                      try:
                          text = read_text(AP_ARN, key, obj['Size'])
                          if not text:
                              scanned += 1
                              continue
                          resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(Text=text, LanguageCode=LANG)
                          ents = resp.get('Entities', [])
                          ts = int(obj['LastModified'].timestamp() * 1000)
                          ddb.put_item(Item={
                              'objectKey': key,
                              'scanTimestamp': ts,
                              'size': obj['Size'],
                              'piiCount': len(ents),
                              'entities': json.dumps(ents, default=str),
                              'languageCode': LANG
                          })
                          findings += len(ents)
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(f"Error scanning {key}: {e}")
                      scanned += 1
                  if scanned >= MAX_FILES:
                      break
              summary = {'scanned': scanned, 'piiFindings': findings}
              if SNS_ARN:
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_ARN, Subject='PII scan complete',
                              Message=json.dumps(summary))
              return summary

          def read_text(bucket, key, size):
              # Read up to first chunk; for larger files sample beginning, middle, end
              if size <= CHUNK_SIZE:
                  body = s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key)['Body'].read(size)
              else:
                  parts = []
                  for start in (0, size // 2, max(0, size - CHUNK_SIZE)):
                      end = min(start + CHUNK_SIZE, size) - 1
                      parts.append(s3.get_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key,
                                                 Range=f'bytes={start}-{end}')['Body'].read())
                  body = b''.join(parts)
              return body.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')[:490000]

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDBGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref SecurityGroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB classification report table.
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  ExampleCliCommand:
    Description: Example CLI invocation of the scanner.
    Value: !Sub 'aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerFunction} --region ${AWS::Region} response.json'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Glue databases and tables for Neptune LPG (Gremlin) and RDF (SPARQL) air-routes data

Parameters:
  LPGDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database for property graph (LPG) tables
  RDFDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables

Resources:
  LPGDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LPGDatabaseName
        Description: Property graph (LPG) tables for Neptune air-routes

  RDFDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RDFDatabaseName
        Description: RDF tables for Neptune air-routes

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: vertex
          separator: ","
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/LPG/airport
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: label
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: alt
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: vertex
          separator: ","
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/LPG/country
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: label
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: vertex
          separator: ","
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/LPG/continent
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: label
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: edge
          separator: ","
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/LPG/route
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: label
              Type: string
            - Name: from
              Type: string
            - Name: to
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref LPGDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: view
          separator: ","
          query: g.V().hasLabel('airport').has('code','DFW').outE('route').limit(10).as('e').inV().as('v').select('e','v').by('code').by('code')
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/LPG/customairport
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: src
              Type: string
            - Name: dest
              Type: string

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: rdf-type
          separator: ","
          queryMode: class
          classuri: class:Airport
          stripUriPrefixes: "true"
          prefixClass: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/
          prefixDatatypeProperty: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/
          prefixObjectProperty: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/RDF/airport
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: label
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: alt
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: rdf-type
          separator: ","
          queryMode: sparql
          stripUriPrefixes: "true"
          prefixClass: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/
          prefixDatatypeProperty: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/
          prefixObjectProperty: http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/
          query: PREFIX c: <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/> PREFIX d: <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/> SELECT ?src ?dest WHERE { ?a c:Airport . ?a d:code ?src . ?a d:icao 'KDFW' . ?b c:Airport . ?b d:code ?dest . ?a ?p ?b . FILTER(?p IN (<http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route>)) } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/RDF/route
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  RouteRdfNoPfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RDFDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          graphType: rdf-type
          separator: ","
          queryMode: sparql
          stripUriPrefixes: "true"
          query: SELECT ?src ?dest WHERE { ?a <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/Airport> . ?a <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?src . ?a <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/icao> 'KDFW' . ?b <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/Airport> . ?b <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty/code> ?dest . ?a <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty/route> ?b . } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: s3://aws-neptune-customer-samples/neptune-sigv4-fluent/airroutes/RDF/route
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.lazy.LazySimpleSerDe
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ","
          Columns:
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

Outputs:
  LPGDatabaseName:
    Description: LPG Glue database name
    Value: !Ref LPGDatabase
  RDFDatabaseName:
    Description: RDF Glue database name
    Value: !Ref RDFDatabase

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication setups - main web app and IoT trusted user provisioning

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: PiBot
    Description: Project name used for resource naming

Resources:
  MainUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-MainUserPool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  MainUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-MainClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref MainUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceError: ENABLED

  MainCognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Main-CognitoUnauthRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MainUnauthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'

  MainCognitoAuthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Main-CognitoAuthRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref MainIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MainAuthPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - cognito-identity:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:ListTagsForResource
                  - kinesisvideo:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: '*'

  MainIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}MainIdentityPool'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref MainUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt MainUserPool.ProviderName

  MainIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref MainIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt MainCognitoAuthRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt MainCognitoUnauthRole.Arn

  ProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ProvisioningUserPool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email

  ProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ProvisioningClient'
      UserPoolId: !Ref ProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceError: ENABLED

  ProvisioningCognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-Provisioning-CognitoUnauthRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration supporting protein variant effect prediction, resolving existing Lambda and Cognito configuration from SSM Parameter Store.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for default resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway for protein variant effect prediction MCP tools
    Description: Description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom name for the AgentCore Gateway. If left blank, a name is auto-generated from the project name.
  LambdaArnParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/lambda/function-arn
    Description: SSM parameter name containing the ARN of the existing Lambda function to invoke.
  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/cognito/discovery-url
    Description: SSM parameter name containing the Cognito JWT discovery URL.
  CognitoClientIdParameter:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/cognito/client-id
    Description: SSM parameter name containing the Cognito app client ID.
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Type: String
    Default: /protein-engineering/agentcore/gateway-role-arn
    Description: SSM parameter name where the new gateway IAM role ARN will be stored.
Conditions:
  IsGatewayNameBlank:
    Fn::Equals:
      - Ref: GatewayName
      - ''
Resources:
  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName:
        Fn::Sub: '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName:
            Fn::Sub: '${ProjectName}-gateway-lambda-invoke'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  Fn::Sub: '{{resolve:ssm:${LambdaArnParameter}}}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value:
            Ref: ProjectName
  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name:
        Ref: GatewayRoleArnParameterName
      Type: String
      Value:
        Fn::GetAtt: GatewayRole.Arn
      Description:
        Fn::Sub: 'ARN of the IAM role used by the ${ProjectName} AgentCore Gateway.'
      Tags:
        Project:
          Ref: ProjectName
  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name:
        Fn::If:
          - IsGatewayNameBlank
          - Fn::Sub: '${ProjectName}-gateway'
          - Ref: GatewayName
      Description:
        Ref: GatewayDescription
      RoleArn:
        Fn::GetAtt: GatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl:
            Fn::Sub: '{{resolve:ssm:${CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter}}}'
          AllowedAudiences:
            - Fn::Sub: '{{resolve:ssm:${CognitoClientIdParameter}}}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value:
            Ref: ProjectName
  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier:
        Fn::GetAtt: AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
      Name:
        Fn::Sub: '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description:
        Fn::Sub: 'MCP target connecting the ${ProjectName} gateway to the protein variant effect prediction Lambda function.'
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          ToolSchema:
            Inline:
              Tools:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: Submit a protein sequence to the variant effect prediction endpoint for processing.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      sequence:
                        type: string
                        description: The protein amino acid sequence to analyze for variant effect prediction.
                      job_name:
                        type: string
                        description: Optional friendly name for the prediction job.
                    required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: Check the completion status and retrieve results of a previously submitted protein variant effect prediction job.
                  InputSchema:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      job_id:
                        type: string
                        description: The identifier of the prediction job returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    required:
                      - job_id
Outputs:
  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt: AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
  GatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt: AgentCoreGateway.GatewayId
  GatewayUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt: AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl
  GatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt: GatewayRole.Arn
  GatewayRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter name where the gateway role ARN is stored.
    Value:
      Ref: GatewayRoleArnParameterName
  GatewayTargetName:
    Description: Name of the gateway target connected to the Lambda function.
    Value:
      Ref: AgentCoreGatewayTarget

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC infrastructure with ALB subnets, Lambda subnet, optional NAT egress, and KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: private-app
    Description: Project name used for resource naming.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ALB subnet in AZ1.
  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for ALB subnet in AZ2.
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the Lambda subnet.
  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a NAT Gateway for internet egress.

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-nat'

  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alb-subnet-1'

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-alb-subnet-2'

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-private-rt'

  NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  AlbSubnet1RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbSubnet2RouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ProjectName} artifact bucket'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-artifact-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-artifact-bucket-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AlbSubnet1Id:
    Description: ALB Subnet 1 ID

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions state machine with two API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) that start executions.
Resources:
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassStatePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                  - states:StopExecution
                Resource: '*'
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pass-workflow'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Simple two-step pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "StepOne",
          "States": {
            "StepOne": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Step one complete",
              "Next": "StepTwo"
            },
            "StepTwo": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Step two complete",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
  ApiGetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
  ApiPostRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
  ApiGet:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-api'
      Description: API to start Step Functions execution via GET
  ApiGetResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGet
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiGet.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start
  ApiGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGet
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiGetResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        RoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGetRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.X-Amz-Target: "'AWSStepFunctions.StartExecution'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"executionArn": $input.json("$.executionArn")}'
          - StatusCode: 400
            SelectionPattern: '.*Error.*'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 400
  ApiGetDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGet
  ApiGetStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiGet
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGetDeployment
      StageName: prod
  ApiPost:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-post-api'
      Description: API to start Step Functions execution via POST
  ApiPostResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiPost
      ParentId: !GetAtt ApiPost.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start
  ApiPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiPost
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiPostResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        RoleArn: !GetAtt ApiPostRole.Arn
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        RequestParameters:
          integration.request.header.X-Amz-Target: "'AWSStepFunctions.StartExecution'"
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"executionArn": $input.json("$.executionArn")}'
          - StatusCode: 400
            SelectionPattern: '.*Error.*'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 400
  ApiPostDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ApiPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiPost
  ApiPostStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiPost
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiPostDeployment
      StageName: prod
Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: GET API endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiGet}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/start
  PostApiEndpoint:
    Description: POST API endpoint
    Value: !Sub https://${ApiPost}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/start

        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem

        - Key: Environment

                Action:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS audit event queue with KMS encryption, optional DLQ, CloudWatch alarms and SNS notifications

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Email address for alarm notifications (optional)
  AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    Description: Alarm threshold (seconds) for age of oldest message
  DLQMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Alarm threshold for number of messages in the DLQ
  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    Description: Max receive count before messages move to DLQ

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionSeconds: 3600
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
    staging:
      MessageRetentionSeconds: 86400
      VisibilityTimeout: 300
    prod:
      MessageRetentionSeconds: 1209600
      VisibilityTimeout: 300

Conditions:
  CreateDLQ: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, ""]]

Resources:
  AuditQueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for audit event SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:Encrypt
            Resource: '*'

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'audit-queue-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sns

  AlarmTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditQueueDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      Squint: false

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'audit-events-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditQueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionSeconds]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - CreateDLQ
        - !Sub
          - '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${DLQArn}","maxReceiveCount":${MaxReceive}}'
          - DLQArn: !GetAtt AuditQueueDLQ.Arn
            MaxReceive: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  AuditQueueOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-events-oldest-message-age-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when the oldest message in the audit queue exceeds the threshold
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]

  AuditQueueDLQAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub 'audit-events-dlq-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when messages appear in the audit events dead letter queue
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueueDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref DLQMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions: [!Ref AlarmTopic]

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events queue
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  AuditQueueName:
    Description: Name of the audit events queue
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
  DLQUrl:
    Description: URL of the dead letter queue (non-dev environments)
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Value: !Ref AuditQueueDLQ
  DLQArn:
    Description: ARN of the dead letter queue (non-dev environments)
    Condition: CreateDLQ
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueueDLQ.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic for alarm notifications
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for queue encryption
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueueKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool for researchapp/AgentCore with clients, groups, Lambda and SSM parameters

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      SoftwareTokenMfaConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'researchapp-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: researchapp
      Name: researchapp-resource-server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp resources

  AdminUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrator group with highest precedence
      Precedence: 1

  CustomerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Customer group
      Precedence: 2

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'researchapp/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'researchapp/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoGroupManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsers
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'researchapp-add-to-customer-group-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          USER_POOL_ID = os.environ['USER_POOL_ID']
          CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME = os.environ['CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME']

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId', USER_POOL_ID)
              user_name = event.get('userName')
              if user_name:
                  try:
                      cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          GroupName=CUSTOMER_GROUP_NAME,
                          Username=user_name
                      )
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error adding user to group: {e}")
                      raise
              return event

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  SSMUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user_pool_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web app client ID

  SSMWebClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt WebAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Web app client secret

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine client ID

  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine-to-machine client secret

  SSMOAuthScopes:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth_scopes
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'researchapp/read'
      Description: OAuth scopes for the resource server

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'
      Description: OIDC discovery URL

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AppSync GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data backed by DynamoDB
Resources:
  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String
          price: String
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }
        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceHistoryItem]
          nextToken: String
        }
        type PriceHistoryItem {
          hk: String
          sk: String
          ticker: String
          price: String
          timestamp: String
        }
        schema {
          query: Query
        }

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Description: Default API Key for CryptoTickerAPI

  HttpDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoHttpDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com
        AuthorizationConfig:
          AuthorizationType: NONE

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  GetTickerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: GetTickerPriceFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt HttpDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "params": {
            "path": "/api/v3/simple/price",
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #set($priceData = $ctx.result.get("$ctx.args.ticker"))
        #if($util.isNull($priceData))
          $util.error("Ticker not found")
        #end
        {
          "ticker": "$ctx.args.ticker",
          "price": "$priceData.usd",
          "timestamp": "$util.time.nowISO8601()"
        }

  PutTickerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: PutTickerRecordFunction
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.ticker),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operations": [
            {
              "operation": "Sequential"
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt GetTickerFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt PutTickerFunction.FunctionId

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25),
          "nextToken": $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.nextToken, null)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        {
          "items": $util.toJson($ctx.result.items),
          "nextToken": $util.toJson($util.defaultIfNull($ctx.result.nextToken, null))
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL API Endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiKey:
    Description: Default API Key
    Value: !GetAtt ApiKey.ApiKey
  DataTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref APIDataTable
