AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints, optional live-to-VOD and VOD workflow support.

Parameters:
  LogicalNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    Description: Logical name prefix used for resource naming.
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value.
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag value.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Output type for the origin endpoints.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Startover window in seconds for the channel.
  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket for live-to-VOD archive storage. If provided, endpoint origination is set to DENY.
  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 bucket containing VOD source content.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']]
  CreateVodRole: !Or
    - Condition: HasArchiveBucket
    - Condition: HasVodSourceBucket

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Name: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: Live streaming channel with optional startover
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-channel'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: HLS origin endpoint
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-hls-endpoint'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: DASH origin endpoint
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Origination: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - DENY
        - ALLOW
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        PeriodTriggers:
          - HLS
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-dash-endpoint'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVodRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      Description: Allows MediaPackage to access VOD source and archive S3 buckets
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-vod-s3-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                    - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - !If
                    - HasVodSourceBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                    - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}'
                    - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - !If
                    - HasArchiveBucket
                    - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                    - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${LogicalNamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage channel ID
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
  HlsEndpointUrl:
    Description: HLS origin endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url
  DashEndpointUrl:
    Description: DASH origin endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url
  VodRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for MediaPackage VOD access
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
    Condition: CreateVodRole

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB table with configurable keys, billing mode, PITR, optional KMS encryption and CloudWatch alarms with SNS alerting.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-application-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the partition key attribute.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of the sort key attribute. Leave empty to omit the sort key.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Data type of the sort key attribute.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Read capacity units (only used with PROVISIONED billing).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Write capacity units (only used with PROVISIONED billing).
  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
  EnableServerSideEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with a customer-managed KMS key.
  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable CloudWatch alarms for throttling and error rates.
  EnableSNSAlerting:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Publish alarm notifications to an SNS topic.
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS topic.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$'

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  UseProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  UseKMS: !Equals [!Ref EnableServerSideEncryption, 'true']
  UseAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']
  UseSNS: !Equals [!Ref EnableSNSAlerting, 'true']
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]
  AlarmsWithSNS: !And [!Condition UseAlarms, !Condition UseSNS]

Resources:
  TableKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: UseKMS
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key for DynamoDB table encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  TableKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: UseKMS
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/dynamodb-${TableName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKMSKey

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - UseProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseKMS
        - SSEEnabled: true
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref TableKMSKey
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  AlarmSNSTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: UseSNS
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${TableName}-alarms'
      DisplayName: DynamoDB Alarms

  AlarmSNSSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmSNSTopic

  ThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-throttled-requests'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when DynamoDB requests are throttled
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref AlarmSNSTopic]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref AlarmSNSTopic]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: UseAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${TableName}-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when DynamoDB system error rate is elevated
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref AlarmSNSTopic]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - UseSNS
        - [!Ref AlarmSNSTopic]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key (if enabled)
    Value: !If
      - UseKMS
      - !GetAtt TableKMSKey.Arn
      - 'KMS encryption not enabled'
  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the alarm SNS topic (if enabled)
    Value: !If
      - UseSNS
      - !Ref AlarmSNSTopic
      - 'SNS alerting not enabled'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipelines building custom AL2023 AMIs (x86 and arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, SSM sudo access, public distribution and organization sharing.

Parameters:
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the AMIs with.
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    Description: Semantic version for the image recipes and pipelines.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$'
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    Description: Root volume size in GB for built images.
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
  X86InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m6i.xlarge
  ArmInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m7g.xlarge

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref X86InstanceType
        - !Ref ArmInstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref ImageBuilderTopic

  ImageBuilderTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic

  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and enables SSM user sudo access.
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftware
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker git
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - DOCKER_CONFIG=/usr/local/lib/docker
                    - mkdir -p $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins
                    - curl -SL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-$(uname -m) -o $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x $DOCKER_CONFIG/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - docker compose version
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y python3-pip
                    - pip3 install --upgrade pip
                    - pip3 install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tests'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Validates Docker Compose and Python package imports.
      Data: |
        name: ValidateSoftware
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker compose version
              - name: ValidatePythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('imports ok')"

  RecipeX86:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true

                              Permanent=True
                          )
                          client.admin_add_user_to_group(

                              Username=user['username'],
                              GroupName=user['group']

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CloudWatch Insights queries and dashboard for AWS Client VPN usage reporting (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth)

Parameters:
  FolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Optional folder path to organize the CloudWatch Insights queries.
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: The Client VPN connection log group name.

Resources:
  UsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/client-vpn-usage-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-attempt-status: (?<connectionStatus>[^,]+)/
        | filter connectionStatus = "successful"
        | stats count(*) as TotalConnections by endpoint as Endpoint
        | sort TotalConnections desc

  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/client-vpn-usage-per-auth-type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /authentication-method: (?<authType>[^,]+)/
        | filter ispresent(authType)
        | stats count(*) as TotalConnections by authType
        | sort TotalConnections desc

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/client-vpn-distinct-users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /username: (?<userName>[^,]+)/
        | filter ispresent(userName)
        | stats count_distinct(userName) as DistinctUsers, count(*) as TotalConnections

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPath}/client-vpn-connection-durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-duration-time: (?<durationSeconds>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(durationSeconds)
        | stats avg(durationSeconds) as AvgDurationSeconds, max(durationSeconds) as MaxDurationSeconds, min(durationSeconds) as MinDurationSeconds, count(*) as TotalConnections by bin(1h) as TimeWindow
        | sort TimeWindow desc

  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub 'ClientVPN-Usage-${AWS::StackName}'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |-
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "table",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "view": "table",
                "query": "q-${UsagePerEndpointQuery}"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "table",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Usage per Authentication Type",
                "view": "table",
                "query": "q-${UsagePerAuthTypeQuery}"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "table",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Distinct Users",
                "view": "table",
                "query": "q-${DistinctUsersQuery}"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "table",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Connection Durations",
                "view": "table",
                "query": "q-${ConnectionDurationsQuery}"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the Client VPN usage dashboard
    Value: !Sub 'ClientVPN-Usage-${AWS::StackName}'

    Description: URL to the Client VPN usage dashboard

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito User Pool for Hospitality Insights (prod) with post-auth Lambda, groups, optional SSO and hosted UI domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. Leave empty to disable.
  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional name of the federated SSO identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  LoginURL:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional SSO login URL used when SSOProviderName is provided.

Conditions:
  HasDomainPrefix: !Not [!Equals [!Ref HostedUIDomainPrefix, '']]
  HasSSO: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, '']]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-userpool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-postauth-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAdminUpdateUser
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-post-auth'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import datetime

          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event.get('userPoolId')
              username = event.get('userName')
              if user_pool_id and username:
                  try:
                      client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=username,
                          UserAttributes=[
                              {
                                  'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                                  'Value': datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
                              }
                          ]
                      )
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f"Error updating last_login: {e}")
              return event

  PostAuthLambdaPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub 'hospitality-insights-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 24
      IdTokenValidity: 24
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdTokenValidity: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !If
          - HasSSO
          - !Sub 'https://${LoginURL}'
          - https://example.com/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - HasSSO
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SSOProviderName
        - - COGNITO

  IdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: HasSSO
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SSOProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        sso_sign_in_url: !Sub 'https://${LoginURL}'
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: HasDomainPrefix
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref HostedUIDomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1
      Description: Administrator group

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2
      Description: Regular user group

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3
      Description: Power user group

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  PostAuthLambdaArn:
    Description: ARN of the post-authentication Lambda
    Value: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn
  HostedUIDomainUrl:
    Condition: HasDomainPrefix
    Description: Hosted UI login URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${HostedUIDomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API for client connection and session state management

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the API Gateway WebSocket stage
  SessionTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: WebSocketSessions
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB session tracking table
  TtlDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    Description: Time-to-live for session records in days

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref SessionTableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              table.put_item(
                  Item={
                      'connectionId': connection_id,
                      'ttl': int(time.time()) + 86400
                  }
              )
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Connected'}

  DefaultFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get('body') or ''
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': body})
              }

  DisconnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event['requestContext']['connectionId']
              table.delete_item(Key={'connectionId': connection_id})
              return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'Disconnected'}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: websocket-session-api
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  ApiStage:

    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  ConnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction

      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/CONNECT

    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultFunction

      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$default

  DisconnectPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission

      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/DISCONNECT

Outputs:

    Value: !Sub wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB session tracking table name
    Value: !Ref SessionTable

    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/fis-chaos-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogKmsKey

  FisExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/fis/chaos-experiments
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogKmsKey.Arn

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'FISChaosExperimentRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FisChaosExperimentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2NetworkDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3ReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketReplication
                  - s3:GetBucketReplication
                  - s3:DeleteBucketReplication
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbReplicationPause
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:ListGlobalTables
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: KmsForLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt FisLogKmsKey.Arn

  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: Chaos experiment blocking regional traffic and pausing cross-region replication
      ExperimentOptions:
        AccountTargeting: single-account
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: fail
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        Name: chaos-network-replication-experiment
        ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      Actions:
        BlockSubnetTrafficToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: aws:networkdisruption:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: Block network traffic from local region subnets to the target region
          Parameters:
            scope: aws:ec2:subnet
            targetRegion: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            Subnets: SubnetsChaosAllowed
          StartAfter: PauseReplication
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:ec2:disrupt-transitgateway-connectivity
          Description: Disrupt transit gateway connectivity
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: TransitGatewaysChaosAllowed
          StartAfter: PauseReplication
        PauseReplication:
          ActionId: aws:fis:inject-api-internal-error
          Description: Placeholder start action
          Duration: PT1M
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:pause-replication
          Description: Pause S3 cross-region replication
          Duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            Buckets: S3BucketsChaosAllowed
          StartAfter: PauseReplication
        PauseDynamoDbReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:pause-replication
          Description: Pause DynamoDB global table replication
          Duration: !Ref ExperimentDuration
          Targets:
            Tables: DynamoDbTablesChaosAllowed
          StartAfter: PauseReplication
      Targets:
        SubnetsChaosAllowed:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          Filters:
            - Path: Tags.ChaosAllowed
              Values:
                - 'true'
        TransitGatewaysChaosAllowed:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          Filters:
            - Path: Tags.ChaosAllowed
              Values:
                - 'true'
        S3BucketsChaosAllowed:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          Filters:
            - Path: Tags.ChaosAllowed
              Values:
                - 'true'
        DynamoDbTablesChaosAllowed:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          Filters:
            - Path: Tags.ChaosAllowed
              Values:
                - 'true'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC network foundation for Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS with VPC Flow Logs

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
    Description: First availability zone
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
    Description: Second availability zone

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/emr-on-eks
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/emr-on-eks
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/emr-on-eks
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/emr-on-eks
          Value: shared

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowVPCFlowLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs*'

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flow-logs*'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc/flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  FlowLogKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogKmsKey.Arn
  FlowLogId:
    Description: VPC Flow Log ID
    Value: !Ref FlowLog

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, workflow, recipe, distribution, lifecycle policy and IAM roles.

Parameters:
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: Instance type used for the image build.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-image-builder-instance-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Path: /

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: sample-image-builder-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfileRoleRef
      Path: /

  ImageBuilderProfileRoleRef:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: AlwaysTrue
    Properties: {}

  LifecyclePolicyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: sample-lifecycle-policy-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /

  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux using WebDownload.
      Data:
        yaml: |
          name: sample-component
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: DownloadChefClient
                  action: WebDownload
                  inputs:
                    - source: https://packages.chef.io/files/stable/chef/17.10.95/ubuntu/22.04/chef_17.10.95-1_amd64.deb
                      destination: /tmp/chef.deb
                - name: InstallChefClient
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - sudo dpkg -i /tmp/chef.deb
            - name: validate
              steps:
                - name: RunChefClient
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - chef-client --version

  SampleWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: sample-workflow
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Updates the SSM agent and builds an AMI.
      Data:
        yaml: |
          name: sample-workflow
          schemaVersion: 1.0
          phases:
            - name: build
              steps:
                - name: UpdateSSMAgent
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - sudo yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                - name: BuildAMI
                  action: ExecuteBash
                  inputs:
                    commands:
                      - echo "Building AMI"

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      ParentImage: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/1.0.0/1
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SampleComponent
        - ComponentArn: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/1.0.0/1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      InstanceProfileName: sample-image-builder-instance-profile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref InstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: sample-image-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              AccountIds:
                - !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref SampleRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref SampleDistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 720
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_ENABLED
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
        EcrRepository:
          RepositoryName: sample-image-scanning-repo
          Tags:
            Environment: Dev
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !Ref SampleWorkflow
          OnFailure: CONTINUE
          ParallelExecution: false

  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months for Environment=Dev resources.
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: sample-recipe
            SemanticVersion: 1.0.0
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeAmi: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 6
            Unit: MONTHS
          ResourceTags:
            Environment: Dev

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the image pipeline
    Value: !Ref SampleImagePipeline
  RecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !Ref SampleRecipe
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !Ref SampleLifecyclePolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Cognito authentication layer for a Lex chatbot web UI with authenticated and unauthenticated access

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: "identity pool"
    Description: Name of the Cognito Identity Pool
  LexV1BotName:
    Type: String
    Default: "OrderFlowers"
    Description: Name of the Lex V1 bot. Leave empty to use Lex V2
  LexV2BotId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Lex V2 bot ID. If provided, Lex V2 permissions are used
  LexV2BotAliasId:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Lex V2 bot alias ID
  ForceCognitoLogin:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: When true, unauthenticated users are denied Lex and live chat API access
  ShouldEnableLiveChat:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: When true, adds execute-api invoke permission for the live chat endpoint
  LiveChatEndpointArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: ARN of the live chat API Gateway method to invoke

Conditions:
  HasLexV2Bot: !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV2BotId, ""]]
  HasLexV1Bot: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref LexV1BotName, ""]]
    - !Not [!Condition HasLexV2Bot]
  EnableLiveChat: !Equals [!Ref ShouldEnableLiveChat, "true"]
  ForceLogin: !Equals [!Ref ForceCognitoLogin, "true"]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-user-pool"
      AliasAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: given_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: preferred_username
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-client"
      GenerateSecret: false
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt UserPool.ProviderName

  AuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-authenticated-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexChatAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasLexV1Bot
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot/${LexV1BotName}"
                - !If
                  - HasLexV2Bot
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}"
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - polly:SynthesizeSpeech
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - EnableLiveChat
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Ref LiveChatEndpointArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-unauthenticated-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LexChatUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasLexV1Bot
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                  Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot/${LexV1BotName}"
                - !If
                  - HasLexV2Bot
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:lex:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:bot-alias/${LexV2BotId}/${LexV2BotAliasId}"
                  - Effect: Allow
                    Action:
                      - lex:RecognizeText
                      - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - EnableLiveChat
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: !Ref LiveChatEndpointArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - ForceLogin
                - Effect: Deny
                  Action:
                    - lex:PostText
                    - lex:PostContent
                    - lex:RecognizeText
                    - lex:RecognizeUtterance
                    - execute-api:Invoke
                  Resource: "*"
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito Identity Pool
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-IdentityPoolId"
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId"
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool Client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId"

    Properties:

  PublicSubnet1Association:

    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcId"

    Description: VPC CIDR block

    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidr"

  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: List of availability zones used
    Value: !Join [",", [!Select [0, !GetAZs ""], !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]]]

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetIds"

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Private subnet IDs

    Export:

Description: Route 53 hosted zone and DNS records for prxu.org (Production) supporting Google Workspace email and CloudFront CDN alias records.
Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: prxu.org.
    Description: The domain name for the hosted zone (with trailing period).
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: Production
    Description: Environment name.
  GoogleSiteVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE-ME
    Description: Google Workspace domain verification TXT value.
  DovetailCdnDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for dovetail-cdn.
  DovetailCdnStagingDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d222222abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for dovetail-cdn-staging.
  FeederCdnDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d333333abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for feeder CDN (f).
  FeederCdnStagingDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d444444abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for feeder staging CDN (f-staging).
  FeederCdnDevelopmentDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d555555abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for feeder development CDN (f.development).
  AdFilesCdnDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d666666abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for ad files CDN (a).
  RyanCdnDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: d777777abcdef8.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront domain for development sandbox CDN (ryan-cdn).
  DovetailRouterProductionDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: router-production.example.com
    Description: Target for dovetail router production CNAME.
  DovetailRouterStagingDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: router-staging.example.com
    Description: Target for dovetail router staging CNAME.
  AuthFeedProxyProductionTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: auth-feed-proxy-production.example.com
    Description: Target for authenticated feed proxy production CNAME.
  AuthFeedProxyStagingTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: auth-feed-proxy-staging.example.com
    Description: Target for authenticated feed proxy staging CNAME.
  AcmValidationDovetailCdnName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.dovetail-cdn.prxu.org.
    Description: ACM validation record name for dovetail-cdn certificate.
  AcmValidationDovetailCdnValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation record value for dovetail-cdn certificate.
  AcmValidationDovetailCdnStagingName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.dovetail-cdn-staging.prxu.org.
    Description: ACM validation record name for dovetail-cdn-staging certificate.
  AcmValidationDovetailCdnStagingValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation record value for dovetail-cdn-staging certificate.
  AcmValidationFeederName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.f.prxu.org.
    Description: ACM validation record name for feeder CDN certificate.
  AcmValidationFeederValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation record value for feeder CDN certificate.
  AcmValidationAdFilesName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.a.prxu.org.
    Description: ACM validation record name for ad files CDN certificate.
  AcmValidationAdFilesValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation record value for ad files CDN certificate.
  AcmValidationRyanCdnName:
    Type: String
    Default: _abc123.ryan-cdn.prxu.org.
    Description: ACM validation record name for ryan-cdn certificate.
  AcmValidationRyanCdnValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _def456.acm-validations.aws.
    Description: ACM validation record value for ryan-cdn certificate.

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Hosted zone for ${DomainName} (${EnvironmentName})'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerification}"'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'

        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      AliasTarget:
        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2
        DNSName: !Ref FeederCdnStagingDomain
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false
  FeederCdnStagingAliasAaaa:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

    Properties:

    Properties:

        HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Simple learning VPC with optional internet gateway, public subnet, route table, and security group.

Parameters:
  NamingPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: SimpleApp1
    Description: Naming prefix for resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet.
  AllowedSourceCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 0.0.0.0/0
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: Source CIDR range allowed for HTTP and HTTPS traffic.
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create an internet gateway.
  CreatePublicSubnet:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a public subnet.
  CreateRouteTable:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a route table.
  CreateSecurityGroup:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a security group.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateInternetGateway: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  ShouldCreatePublicSubnet: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnet, 'true']
  ShouldCreateRouteTable: !Equals [!Ref CreateRouteTable, 'true']
  ShouldCreateSecurityGroup: !Equals [!Ref CreateSecurityGroup, 'true']
  ShouldCreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation: !And
    - !Condition ShouldCreatePublicSubnet
    - !Condition ShouldCreateRouteTable

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: ShouldCreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: ShouldCreateInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: ShouldCreatePublicSubnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-PublicSubnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: ShouldCreateRouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldCreateInternetGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: ShouldCreateSubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: ShouldCreateSecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTP and HTTPS traffic from specified source range
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedSourceCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamingPrefix}-WebSecurityGroup'

Outputs:
  VPCId:
    Description: The ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
