AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing zone hub VPC with Transit Gateway, NAT gateways, flow logs, and VPC endpoints for multi-account spoke attachment.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Environment name prefix used for resource naming and tagging.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRouteTable1TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRouteTable2TgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayAttachment:

    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

      Ipv6Support: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs'

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'

        Statement:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole

          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface

        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      VpcEndpointType: Interface

        - !Ref EndpointsSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:

    Properties:

        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Description: Student Services agent infrastructure with per-domain Cognito OAuth2 and least-privilege IAM execution roles for AWS Bedrock AgentCore

      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'student-services-base-policy-${AWS::Region}'

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: 'bedrock-agentcore'
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetTraceSummary
              - xray:GetTraceGraph
              - xray:BatchGetTraces
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
              - ssm:PutParameter
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'student-services-agent-execution-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com

            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy

  GatewayUserPool:

      UserPoolName: !Sub 'student-services-gateway-pool-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 6
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  GatewayUserPoolDomain:

        - client_credentials

        - student-services-gateway/invoke
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_NO_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH

  GatewayExecutionRole:

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BaseManagedPolicy

          RequireSymbols: false

        - Name: email

    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub 'course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - CloudTrail log monitoring with metric filters, alarms, and Insights queries.

Parameters:
  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to receive alarm notifications.
    AllowedPattern: "^[^@]+@[^@]+\\.[^@]+$"
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 731, 1096, 1826, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]

Resources:
  CisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CIS benchmark SNS topic and CloudWatch Logs log group encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  CisKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cis-benchmark-key-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CisKmsKey

  AlarmSnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'cis-benchmark-alarms-${AWS::AccountId}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CisKmsKey
      Subscription:
        - Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail
          Protocol: email

  AlarmSnsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmSnsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmSnsTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/cis-events-${AWS::AccountId}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref CisKmsKey

  MetricFilterUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterConsoleSigninNoMfa:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleSigninNoMfa
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterRootUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: RootUsage
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterIamPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = DeleteGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachGroupPolicy) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterCloudTrailConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateTrail) || ($.eventName = UpdateTrail) || ($.eventName = DeleteTrail) || ($.eventName = StartLogging) || ($.eventName = StopLogging) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterConsoleLoginFailures:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = ConsoleLogin) && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterKmsKeyDisableOrDelete:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = kms.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = DisableKey) || ($.eventName = ScheduleKeyDeletion)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: KmsKeyDisableOrDelete
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterS3BucketPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = s3.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = PutBucketAcl) || ($.eventName = PutBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutBucketCors) || ($.eventName = PutBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = PutBucketReplication) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketCors) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketReplication)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterAwsConfigChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = config.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = StopConfigurationRecorder) || ($.eventName = DeleteDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutConfigurationRecorder)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: AwsConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterSecurityGroupChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = CreateSecurityGroup) || ($.eventName = DeleteSecurityGroup) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: SecurityGroupChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterNaclChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: NaclChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterNetworkGatewayChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateCustomerGateway) || ($.eventName = DeleteCustomerGateway) || ($.eventName = AttachInternetGateway) || ($.eventName = CreateInternetGateway) || ($.eventName = DeleteInternetGateway) || ($.eventName = DetachInternetGateway) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: NetworkGatewayChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterRouteTableChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateRoute) || ($.eventName = CreateRouteTable) || ($.eventName = DeleteRoute) || ($.eventName = DeleteRouteTable) || ($.eventName = ReplaceRoute) || ($.eventName = ReplaceRouteTableAssociation) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: RouteTableChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: '0'

  MetricFilterVpcChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup

      QueryString: |

  QueryS3BucketPolicyChanges:

      QueryString: |

  QueryNetworkGatewayChanges:

  QueryRouteTableChanges:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Enables AWS Security Hub across an AWS Organization managed by Control Tower, with the audit account as delegated administrator.

Parameters:
  AuditAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Account ID of the audit account (delegated Security Hub administrator)
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
  LogArchiveAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Account ID of the log archive account
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'

Resources:
  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: securityhub-automation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: securityhub-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListMembers
                  - securityhub:GetMasterAccount
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:GetInvitationsCount
                  - securityhub:BatchEnableStandards
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-execution/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/securityhub.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForSecurityHub'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: securityhub.amazonaws.com

  EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: superwerker-enable-security-hub-delegated-admin
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Audit account id
          LogArchiveAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Log archive account id
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAccount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: EnableSecurityHub
              AssumeRoleCredential: ASSUME_ROLE
              AssumeRoleControl:
                RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::{{ AuditAccountId }}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RoleSessionName: SecurityHubEnablement
            onFailure: Continue
          - name: EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
              AdminAccountId: '{{ AuditAccountId }}'
            onFailure: Continue
          - name: WaitForAdminAccount
            action: aws:waitForAwsResourceProperty
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
              AdminAccountId: '{{ AuditAccountId }}'
              PropertySelector: 'AdminAccounts[0].AccountId'
              DesiredValues:
                - '{{ AuditAccountId }}'
          - name: InviteLogArchiveAccount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: InviteMembers
              AssumeRoleCredential: ASSUME_ROLE
              AssumeRoleControl:
                RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::{{ AuditAccountId }}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RoleSessionName: SecurityHubInvite
              AccountIds:
                - '{{ LogArchiveAccountId }}'

  EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: superwerker-enable-security-hub-member
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: Member account id
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Audit account id
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInMemberAccount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: EnableSecurityHub
              AssumeRoleCredential: ASSUME_ROLE
              AssumeRoleControl:
                RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::{{ AccountId }}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RoleSessionName: SecurityHubEnablement
            onFailure: Continue
          - name: GetInvitationCount
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            outputs:
              - Name: Count
                Selector: $.InvitationCount
                Type: Integer
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: GetInvitationsCount
              AssumeRoleCredential: ASSUME_ROLE
              AssumeRoleControl:
                RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::{{ AccountId }}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RoleSessionName: SecurityHubAccept
          - name: AcceptInvitation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              Service: securityhub
              Api: AcceptInvitation
              AssumeRoleCredential: ASSUME_ROLE
              AssumeRoleControl:
                RoleArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::{{ AccountId }}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
                RoleSessionName: SecurityHubAccept
              MasterId: '{{ AuditAccountId }}'
              InvitationId: '{{ GetInvitationCount.Count }}'

  EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: securityhub-eventbridge-invoke-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-ssm-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn

  LandingZoneFinishedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: superwerker-securityhub-landing-zone-finished
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - "Control Tower Management Event"
        detail:
          eventName:
            - "SucceedLandingZoneSetup"
      Targets:
        - Id: EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdmin
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument}:1'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              audit: "$.detail.organizationId"
            InputTemplate: >-
              {
                "AuditAccountId": "${AuditAccountIdParameter}",
                "LogArchiveAccountId": "${LogArchiveAccountIdParameter}"
              }

  NewAccountProvisionedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: superwerker-securityhub-new-account
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - "Control Tower Lifecycle Event"
        detail:
          eventName:
            - "CreateManagedAccount"
          serviceEventDetails:
            createManagedAccountStatus:
              state:
                - "SUCCEEDED"
      Targets:
        - Id: EnableSecurityHubMember
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument}:1'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              account: "$.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId"
            InputTemplate: !Sub >-
              {
                "AccountId": "<account>",
                "AuditAccountId": "${AuditAccountId}"
              }

  LogArchiveOnboardingRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: superwerker-securityhub-log-archive
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - "Control Tower Lifecycle Event"
        detail:
          eventName:
            - "UpdateManagedAccount"
          serviceEventDetails:
            updateManagedAccountStatus:
              state:
                - "SUCCEEDED"
      Targets:
        - Id: EnableSecurityHubMemberLogArchive
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument}:1'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              account: "$.detail.serviceEventDetails.updateManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId"
            InputTemplate: !Sub >-
              {
                "AccountId": "<account>",
                "AuditAccountId": "${AuditAccountId}"
              }

  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/securityhub/audit-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref AuditAccountId

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/securityhub/log-archive-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref LogArchiveAccountId

Outputs:
  AutomationRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role used by SSM Automation for cross-account Security Hub enablement
    Value: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
  DelegatedAdminDocumentName:
    Description: SSM document enabling Security Hub delegated administration
    Value: !Ref EnableSecurityHubDelegatedAdminDocument
  MemberDocumentName:
    Description: SSM document enabling Security Hub in member accounts
    Value: !Ref EnableSecurityHubMemberDocument
  NewAccountRuleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for EKS deployments

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment alias used as role name prefix
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: abc123
    Description: Environment hash used for unique naming
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name to scope bastion role S3 GetObject access
  # PermissionsBoundary:
  #   Type: String
  #   Description: ARN of the permissions boundary to apply to all roles
  #   Default: ''

Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  KubernetesResourceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
      RetentionInDays: 30

  KubernetesHelmLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EksClusterLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
      RetentionInDays: 30

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-logging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-identity-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-cfn-cloudtrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  EksNodeGroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: describe-nodegroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                Resource: '*'

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role'
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution-broad
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:*
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-logging-delivery-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: logging-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  CodeBuildEksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-codebuild-eks-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codebuild.amazonaws.com
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codebuild-eks-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  CfnHooksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-hooks-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: hooks-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - eks:*
                  - s3:*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:*
                  - cloudwatch:*
                  - ssm:*
                Resource: '*'

  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-instance-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bastion-permissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${S3BucketName}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  KubernetesResourceActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::ResourceVersion
    DependsOn:
      - CloudFormationExecutionRole
      - LoggingDeliveryRole
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      SchemaHandlerPackage: !Sub 'https://awsqs-kubernetes-resource.s3.amazonaws.com/awsqs-kubernetes-resource-1.0.0.zip'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn

  KubernetesResourceTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - KubernetesResourceActivation
      - KubernetesResourceLogGroup
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      MajorVersion: 1
      Type: RESOURCE

  KubernetesHelmTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - CloudFormationExecutionRole
      - LoggingDeliveryRole
      - KubernetesHelmLogGroup
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      MajorVersion: 1
      Type: RESOURCE

  EksClusterTypeActivation:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::TypeActivation
    DependsOn:
      - CloudFormationExecutionRole
      - LoggingDeliveryRole
      - EksClusterLogGroup
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::EKS::Cluster
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroupName: cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
      MajorVersion: 1
      Type: RESOURCE

Outputs:
  GuardDutyDetectorId:
    Description: GuardDuty Detector ID
    Value: !Ref GuardDutyDetector
  LambdaDiscoveryRoleArn:
    Description: Lambda discovery role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaDiscoveryRole.Arn
  LambdaCallerIdentityRoleArn:
    Description: Lambda caller identity role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaCallerIdentityRole.Arn
  EksNodeGroupDescribeRoleArn:
    Description: EKS node group describe role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt EksNodeGroupDescribeRole.Arn
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: CloudFormation execution role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  LoggingDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: Logging delivery role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
  CodeBuildEksRoleArn:
    Description: CodeBuild/EKS role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildEksRole.Arn
  CfnHooksRoleArn:
    Description: CloudFormation hooks role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CfnHooksRole.Arn
  BastionInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: Bastion instance role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt BastionInstanceRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS test infrastructure with FIFO/standard queues, DLQs, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms
Resources:
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
  QueueEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/sqs-test-queues
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
  StandardDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-test-dlq
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
  FifoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-test-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
  FifoSeparateDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-separate-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: standard-test-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
  FifoQueueNoDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-no-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
  FifoQueueWithDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: fifo-with-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-messages-sent
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent on the standard queue breaching at 1
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
  FifoWithDLQAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection on average messages sent for the FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Metrics:
        - Id: ad1
          Type: MetricMath
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: MessagesSentAnomalyBand
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDLQ.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: true
  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
  FifoSeparateQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-separate-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue exceeds 183500 bytes
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoSeparateDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
  StandardDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Visible messages on the standard DLQ greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
  FifoDLQVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Visible messages on the FIFO DLQ greater than zero
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDLQ.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: standard-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on the standard queue exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
  FifoSeparateQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: fifo-separate-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on the separate FIFO queue exceeds 15 seconds
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private networking for a ROSA cluster with AWS PrivateLink, including an egress VPC with NAT and a Transit Gateway.

Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Description: Number of availability zones for the ROSA VPC subnets.
  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'No'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'Yes'
      - 'No'
  EnableVpcFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'No'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'Yes'
      - 'No'
  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: alias/vpc-flow-logs-key
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 180
      - 365
      - 730
      - 1095
      - 1825
      - 3653

Conditions:
  HasThreeAZs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, '3']
  CreateElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'Yes']
  CreateFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpcFlowLogs, 'Yes']

Resources:
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for ROSA load balancers

  FlowLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowVPCFlowLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs*'

  FlowLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Ref FlowLogKmsKeyAlias
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/vpc-flow-logs
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogKmsKey

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VPCFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs:*'

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: CreateFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-vpc

  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-subnet-1

  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-subnet-2

  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-subnet-3

  RosaRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-rt

  RosaSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  RosaSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  RosaSubnet3Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-vpc

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-public-subnet

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-private-subnet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-igw

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-nat

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: Transit Gateway for ROSA egress
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: false
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: false
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-tgw-rt

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-attachment

  RosaTgwAttachment2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-attachment-2

  RosaTgwAttachment3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref RosaSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rosa-attachment-3

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: egress-attachment

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment2
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment2

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment3
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment3

  EgressTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  RosaTgwRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  RosaTgwRouteTablePropagation2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment2
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment2

  RosaTgwRouteTablePropagation3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Condition: HasThreeAZs
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment3
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment3

  EgressTgwRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  RosaDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ROSA VPC ID
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
  RosaSubnetIds:
    Description: ROSA VPC subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - !If
        - HasThreeAZs
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1, !Ref RosaSubnet2, !Ref RosaSubnet3]
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1]
  EgressVpcId:
    Description: Egress VPC ID
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: Egress public subnet ID
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Egress private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: Transit Gateway route table ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: NAT Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: Internet Gateway ID
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
