AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Prerequisite resources and nine SSM Automation documents for PCI DSS automated remediation, with outputs exported for AWS Config conformance packs.

Resources:
  TrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: cloudtrail-remediation-log-group
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      KmsKeyId: !Ref TrailKMSKey

  TrailKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudTrail log encryption (PCI DSS remediation)
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  TrailKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cloudtrail-remediation-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TrailKMSKey

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: ssm-pci-remediation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - !Sub arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: cloudtrail-cloudwatch-logs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt TrailLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  SSMEncryptCloudTrailTrail:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-EncryptCloudTrailTrail
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a CloudTrail trail with a KMS key and integrates it with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          KMSKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KMSKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  SSMEnableKMSKeyRotation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-EnableKMSKeyRotation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables key rotation for a specified KMS key.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  SSMIntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-IntegrateCloudTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrates a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  SSMUpdateIAMPasswordPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-UpdateIAMPasswordPolicy
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates the account IAM password policy to meet PCI DSS requirements.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  SSMEnableTrailLogValidation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-EnableTrailLogValidation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables log file validation for a CloudTrail trail while ensuring multi-region and CloudWatch integration.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail
          LogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: CloudWatch Logs log group ARN
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrail
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ LogGroupArn }}'
          - name: EnableLogFileValidation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  SSMRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on a given default security group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetSecurityGroupDetails
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            outputs:
              - Name: IpPermissions
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions
              - Name: IpPermissionsEgress
                Selector: $.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
          - name: RevokeIngressRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    perms = events['IpPermissions'] or []
                    if perms:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=perms
                        )
          - name: RevokeEgressRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    sg_id = events['SecurityGroupId']
                    perms = events['IpPermissionsEgress'] or []
                    if perms:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=sg_id,
                            IpPermissions=perms
                        )
            inputs2: {}
        inputs:
          SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
          IpPermissions: '{{ GetSecurityGroupDetails.IpPermissions }}'
          IpPermissionsEgress: '{{ GetSecurityGroupDetails.IpPermissionsEgress }}'

  SSMDeleteSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-DeleteSecurityGroup
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes a specified security group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'

  SSMReleaseElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-ReleaseElasticIP
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  SSMRemoveCodeBuildSecretEnvVars:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: PCI-RemoveCodeBuildSecretEnvVars
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates a CodeBuild project to remove AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveSecretEnvVars
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.8
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    response = codebuild.batch_get_project(names=[project_name])
                    projects = response.get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception('Project not found: ' + project_name)
                    project = projects[0]
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    filtered = [
                        v for v in env_vars
                        if v.get('name') not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    ]
                    env['environmentVariables'] = filtered
                    project['environment'] = env
                    project.pop('name', None)
                    project.pop('arn', None)
                    project.pop('created', None)
                    project.pop('lastModified', None)
                    project.pop('webhook', None)
                    project.pop('vpcConfig', None) if not project.get('vpcConfig') else None
                    codebuild.update_project(**project)

              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'

Outputs:

      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchRoleArn

    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EncryptCloudTrailTrailDocument

  EnableTrailLogValidationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the enable trail log validation automation document
    Value: !Ref SSMEnableTrailLogValidation
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EnableTrailLogValidationDocument
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the revoke default security group rules automation document
    Value: !Ref SSMRevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the delete security group automation document
    Value: !Ref SSMDeleteSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DeleteSecurityGroupDocument
  ReleaseElasticIPDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the release Elastic IP automation document
    Value: !Ref SSMReleaseElasticIP
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ReleaseElasticIPDocument

    Description: Name of the remove CodeBuild secret environment variables automation document
    Value: !Ref SSMRemoveCodeBuildSecretEnvVars
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: CDK bootstrap environment (template version 6)

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: "[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}"
    Description: Short unique qualifier to identify resources.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: List of trusted account IDs allowed to assume the deployment roles.
  ManagedPolicyArns:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: Additional managed policy ARNs to attach to the deployment action role.
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom name for the file assets bucket.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional ARN of an existing KMS key to use instead of creating one.
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "6"
    Description: Bootstrap version to record in SSM.

Conditions:
  HasCustomBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetsBucketName, ""]]
  HasExistingKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, ""]]
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HasManagedPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref ManagedPolicyArns], ""]]

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: HasExistingKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CDK file assets encryption key
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: KeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: KeyUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: "*"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role"

  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: HasExistingKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey

  FileAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - HasExistingKey
                - !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey
                - !Ref KmsKeyArn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  FileAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowHttpsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false
          - Sid: AllowPublishingRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256

  ContainerAssetsRepositoryPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ECR::RepositoryPolicy
    Properties:
      Repository: !Ref ContainerAssetsRepository
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImagePublishing
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:DescribeImages
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:DescribeImages

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:Abort*
                  - s3:DeleteObject*
                  - s3:GetBucket*
                  - s3:GetObject*
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:PutObject*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - !If
                - HasExistingKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Decrypt
                    - kms:DescribeKey
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                    - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: "*"

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LookupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - route53:ListHostedZones
                  - route53:ListHostedZonesByName
                  - route53:ListResourceRecordSets
                Resource: "*"

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deployment-action-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !If
                - HasTrustedAccounts
                - !Split [",", !Join [",", !Ref TrustedAccounts]]
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateTerminationProtection
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerAssetsRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: "*"
              - !If
                - HasManagedPolicies
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                    - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  Resource: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
                  Condition:
                    StringEquals:
                      iam:PolicyArn: !Ref ManagedPolicyArns
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess"

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: Version of the CDK bootstrap environment.

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref FileAssetsBucket
  BucketDomainName:
    Description: File assets bucket domain name
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetsBucket.DomainName
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for file assets
    Value: !If
      - HasExistingKey
      - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn

  ContainerAssetsRepositoryName:

  FilePublishingRoleArn:

  BootstrapVersionParameterName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment environment with temporary green environment for traffic routing.
Parameters:
  CreateNewApp:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Whether to create a new Elastic Beanstalk application or reference an existing one.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-eb-app
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-eb-env
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023 v6.7.0 running Node.js 20
    Description: Solution stack for the environment.
  S3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: S3 bucket containing the sample application bundle. Leave empty to use the default bucket for the current region.
  S3Key:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-v3/node-v20-noinstallexpress.zip
    Description: S3 key of the sample application bundle.
Conditions:
  CreateApplicationCondition: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewApp, 'true']
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref S3Bucket, '']
Resources:
  EBApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateApplicationCondition
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Elastic Beanstalk application for blue-green deployments
  EBEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplicationCondition
        - !Ref EBApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:application
          OptionName: Application Version SourceBundle
          Value: !Sub
            - s3://${BucketName}/${S3Key}
            - BucketName: !If
                - UseDefaultBucket
                - !Sub elastic-beanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}
                - !Ref S3Bucket
  BlueGreenLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSLambdaExecute
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ElasticBeanstalkSwapAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                  - elasticbeanstalk:TerminateEnvironment
                  - elasticbeanstalk:CreateEnvironment
                  - elasticbeanstalk:CreateApplicationVersion
                  - elasticbeanstalk:UpdateEnvironment
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
  BlueGreenLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt BlueGreenLambdaRole.Arn
      Runtime: python3.12
      Timeout: 300
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import time

          eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  request_type = event['RequestType']
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  blue = props['BlueEnvironmentName']
                  green = props['GreenEnvironmentName']
                  if request_type in ['Create', 'Update']:
                      eb.swap_environment_cnames(
                          SourceEnvironmentName=blue,
                          DestinationEnvironmentName=green
                      )
                      time.sleep(30)
                      eb.swap_environment_cnames(
                          SourceEnvironmentName=green,
                          DestinationEnvironmentName=blue
                      )
                      time.sleep(30)
                      envs = eb.describe_environments(
                          EnvironmentNames=[green],
                          IncludeDeleted=False
                      )['Environments']
                      if envs and envs[0]['Status'] not in ['Terminated', 'Terminating']:
                          eb.terminate_environment(
                              EnvironmentName=green,
                              ForceTerminate=True
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})
  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplicationCondition
        - !Ref EBApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-green
      SolutionStackName: !Ref SolutionStackName
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:application
          OptionName: Application Version SourceBundle
          Value: !Sub
            - s3://${BucketName}/${S3Key}
            - BucketName: !If
                - UseDefaultBucket
                - !Sub elastic-beanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}
                - !Ref S3Bucket
  BlueGreenSwapResource:
    Type: Custom::BlueGreenSwap
    DependsOn:
      - EBEnvironment
      - GreenEnvironment
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt BlueGreenLambda.Arn
      BlueEnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      GreenEnvironmentName: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-green
Outputs:
  BlueEnvironmentURL:
    Description: URL of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment
    Value: !GetAtt EBEnvironment.EndpointURL
  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Description: Name of the temporary green environment
    Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-green
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk application name
    Value: !If
      - CreateApplicationCondition
      - !Ref EBApplication
      - !Ref ApplicationName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Service Catalog environment for ML workshop with admin and end user portfolios, products, launch roles and end user roles
Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    Description: Root S3 URL for nested CloudFormation product templates
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    Description: Environment prefix for resources
Resources:
  AdminLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'SC-MLWorkshop-AdminLaunch-${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonVPCFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSDataExchangeFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMFullAccess
  EndUserLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'SC-MLWorkshop-EndUserLaunch-${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonVPCFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSDataExchangeFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMFullAccess
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-Admin-Portfolio-${EnvironmentName}'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: Admin portfolio for ML workshop
  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-EndUser-Portfolio-${EnvironmentName}'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshop
      Description: End user portfolio for ML workshop
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-VPC-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: VPC with private subnets and endpoints
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/vpc.template'
  IAMProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-IAM-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/iam.template'
  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-DataExchange-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: AWS Data Exchange product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/dataexchange.template'
  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-Infrastructure-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Infrastructure product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/infrastructure.template'
  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-Application-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Application product
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/application.template'
  SageMakerProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-SageMaker-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/sagemaker.template'
  ThirdPartyModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-ThirdPartyModel-${EnvironmentName}'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Third-party ML model
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/thirdpartymodel.template'
  AdminVPCConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminVPCAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn
  AdminIAMConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminIAMAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn
  AdminDataExchangeConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminDataExchangeAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn
  AdminInfrastructureConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminInfrastructureAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn
  AdminApplicationConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: AdminApplicationAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminLaunchRole.Arn
  EndUserSageMakerConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserSageMakerAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn
  EndUserThirdPartyModelConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: EndUserThirdPartyModelAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyModelProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt EndUserLaunchRole.Arn
  AdminVPCAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct
  AdminIAMAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMProduct
  AdminDataExchangeAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
  AdminInfrastructureAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
  AdminApplicationAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct
  EndUserSageMakerAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerProduct
  EndUserThirdPartyModelAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyModelProduct
  AdminPrincipalAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt AdminLeadEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM
  EndUserPrincipalAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      PrincipalARN: !GetAtt DeveloperEndUserRole.Arn
      PrincipalType: IAM
  AdminLeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-AdminLeadEndUser-${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLWorkshopReadDescribe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:Describe*
                  - servicecatalog:List*
                  - servicecatalog:Search*
                  - servicecatalog:Get*
                  - sagemaker:Describe*
                  - sagemaker:List*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListKeys
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:Get*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLWorkshopSSMAndS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/provisioning: 'true'
  DeveloperEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'MLWorkshop-DeveloperEndUser-${EnvironmentName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLWorkshopReadDescribe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:Describe*
                  - servicecatalog:List*
                  - servicecatalog:Search*
                  - servicecatalog:Get*
                  - sagemaker:Describe*
                  - sagemaker:List*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListKeys
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:Get*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: MLWorkshopSSMAndS3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::*/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/provisioning: 'true'
Outputs:
  AdminLeadEndUserSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Switch role URL for the admin lead end user
    Value: !Sub 'https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${AdminLeadEndUserRole}&displayName=AdminLeadEndUser'
  DeveloperEndUserSwitchRoleURL:
    Description: Switch role URL for the developer end user
    Value: !Sub 'https://signin.aws.amazon.com/switchrole?account=${AWS::AccountId}&roleName=${DeveloperEndUserRole}&displayName=DeveloperEndUser'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Dual-stack VPC for staging or production environment

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: staging
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment to deploy
  DeployNAT:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT gateway for private subnets

Conditions:
  CreateNAT: !Equals [!Ref DeployNAT, 'true']

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.20.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1: 10.20.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.20.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.20.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.20.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.20.11.0/24
      DomainName: staging.example.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.10.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1: 10.10.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2: 10.10.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3: 10.10.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1: 10.10.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2: 10.10.11.0/24
      DomainName: production.example.internal

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'

  VPCIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DhcpOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-dhcp'

  VPCDhcpOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DhcpOptions

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-3'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-rt'

  PublicRouteV4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteV6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateRouteV6Egress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNAT
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat'

  PrivateRouteV4NAT:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNAT
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-nacl'

  PublicInboundHttpV4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:

    Properties:

      PortRange:

      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:

    Properties:

      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024
        To: 65535

    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: 6

      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0

      RuleNumber: 110

      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Movies API with DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway
Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: Movies
Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${TableName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
  MoviesLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'movies-lambda-role-${Environment}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
  CreateMoviesLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-create-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  ReadMoviesLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-read-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  UpdateMoviesLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-update-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  DeleteMoviesLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-delete-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMoviesLogGroup
      - MoviesLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-create-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          import uuid

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  title = body.get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})}
                  item = {'title': title, 'year': body.get('year'), 'genre': body.get('genre'), 'id': str(uuid.uuid4())}
                  table.put_item(Item=item)
                  return {'statusCode': 201, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps(item)}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})}

          def cors():
              return {
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,GET,PUT,DELETE'
              }
  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ReadMoviesLogGroup
      - MoviesLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-read-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})}
                  response = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})

                  if not item:

                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps(item, default=str)}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})}

          def cors():
              return {
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,GET,PUT,DELETE'
              }
  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - UpdateMoviesLogGroup
      - MoviesLambdaRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-update-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('title')
                  if not title:
                      return {'statusCode': 400, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': 'title is required'})}
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  update_expression = 'SET '
                  expression_values = {}
                  for key, value in body.items():
                      if key != 'title':
                          update_expression += f'#{k} = :{k}, '.replace('#k', f'#{key}')
                          expression_values[f':{key}'] = value
                  update_expression = update_expression.rstrip(', ')
                  expression_names = {f'#{k}': k for k in body if k != 'title'}
                  response = table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=expression_names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_values,
                      ReturnValues='ALL_NEW'
                  )
                  return {'statusCode': 200, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps(response.get('Attributes', {}), default=str)}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {'statusCode': 500, 'headers': cors(), 'body': json.dumps({'message': str(e)})}

          def cors():
              return {
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
                  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,GET,PUT,DELETE'
              }

      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  title = event.get('pathParameters', {}).get('title')
                  if not title:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SageMaker Studio MLOps Engineer user profile with scoped execution role

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. If empty, a new domain is created.
  ExistingSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group IDs associated with the existing domain.
  ExistingSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs associated with the existing domain.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when no domain ID is provided.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet created when no domain ID is provided.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingDomainId], '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref ExistingDomainId], '']]

Resources:
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'sagemaker-mlops-engineer-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsEngineerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassPerUserRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/sagemaker-*'
              - Sid: SageMakerPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelMonitoring
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlerts
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringAlert
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ExperimentsLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:Search
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineage
                  - sagemaker:ListLineage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Jobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Endpoints
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: StudioAppsSpacesOwned
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
              - Sid: StudioAppsSpacesList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                Resource: '*'

  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-vpc'

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-subnet'

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: SageMaker Studio security group
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-domain'
      AuthMode: SSO
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref Subnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt SecurityGroup.GroupId

  MLOpsUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      UserProfileName: mlops-engineer
      DomainId: !If
        - UseExistingDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
        - !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn

Outputs:
  UserProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the MLOps engineer user profile
    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsUserProfile.UserProfileArn
  DomainId:
    Description: SageMaker Studio domain ID
    Value: !If

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance benchmarks

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/benchmarks/db-encryption-sdk
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group receiving benchmark result events
  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Log retention period in days

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref RetentionInDays

  JavaMemoryEfficiencyFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricValue: $.memory_efficiency_ratio
          Dimensions:
            - Name: Language
              Value: Java

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "memory" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricName: PeakMemoryMB
          MetricValue: $.peak_memory_mb
          Dimensions:
            - Name: Language
              Value: Java

  JavaThroughputP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.data_size_bytes = 1048576 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricName: ThroughputP50LatencyMs
          MetricValue: $.p50_latency_ms
          Dimensions:
            - Name: Language
              Value: Java

  JavaThroughputP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.data_size_bytes = 1048576 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricName: ThroughputP95LatencyMs
          MetricValue: $.p95_latency_ms
          Dimensions:
            - Name: Language
              Value: Java

  JavaThroughputP99Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "throughput" && $.language = "Java" && $.data_size_bytes = 1048576 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: DBEncryptionBenchmarks/Java
          MetricName: ThroughputP99LatencyMs
          MetricValue: $.p99_latency_ms
          Dimensions:
            - Name: Language
              Value: Java

  JavaConcurrencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.test_type = "concurrency" && $.language = "Java" }'
      MetricTransformations:
