Description: IAM identities and permissions for Cluster API Provider AWS bootstrap and operation

              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets

              - ec2:StartInstances

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneManagedPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersManagedPolicy

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'capa-control-plane-${AWS::StackName}'

        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub 'capa-controllers-${AWS::StackName}'

        Version: '2012-10-17'

          - Effect: Allow

              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com

              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'capa-controllers-${AWS::StackName}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  WorkersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'capa-workers-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Ref ControlPlaneManagedPolicy

  WorkersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'capa-workers-${AWS::StackName}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkersRole

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'capa-eks-control-plane-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController

  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub 'capa-bootstrappers-${AWS::StackName}'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersManagedPolicy

  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub 'capa-bootstrapper-${AWS::StackName}'
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup

  BootstrapperGroupName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience with configurable NAT Gateway setup and VPC Flow Logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging.
  NatGatewayType:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - per-az
    Description: Deploy a single NAT Gateway (cost-effective) or one NAT Gateway per AZ (high availability).

Conditions:
  CreateSingleNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'single']
  CreatePerAzNat: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayType, 'per-az']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.101.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.102.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.103.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateSingleNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateSingleNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-1'

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP3.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gw-3'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreateSingleNat
        - !Ref NatGateway1
        - !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreateSingleNat
        - !Ref NatGateway1
        - !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateRoute3:

    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If

        - !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup:

        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub '${FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsCloudWatchLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log'

Outputs:

  PublicSubnetIds:

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: Private subnet 3 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet3Id'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PublicSubnet3Id:

  NatGatewayIds:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Isolated private VPC for AI customer support application with VPC endpoints, KMS-encrypted flow logs, and component security groups.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  Subnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  Subnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
  Subnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
  Az1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
  Az2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
  Az3:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1c
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFlowLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${ProjectName}*
          - Sid: AllowLogsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-flowlogs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpc

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-az1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-az2

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref Subnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref Az3
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-az3

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-private-rt

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  Subnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-vpce-sg

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Agent Runtime component - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-sg

  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MCP Runtime component - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC endpoints
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-mcp-runtime-sg

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda functions - HTTPS egress to VPC endpoints and DynamoDB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to VPC endpoints
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB endpoint
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-lambda-sg

  BedrockRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.bedrock-runtime
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for DynamoDB interface endpoint
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${ProjectName}-dynamodb-vpce-sg

  DynamoDbEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DynamoDbEndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  RdsDataEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.rds-data
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SecretsManagerEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  XRayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.xray
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${ProjectName}
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-flowlogs-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the isolated VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Private subnet IDs across three AZs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for Agent Runtime
    Value: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
  MCPRuntimeSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for MCP Runtime
    Value: !Ref MCPRuntimeSecurityGroup
  LambdaSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for Lambda functions
    Value: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  FlowLogId:
    Description: VPC Flow Log ID
    Value: !Ref FlowLog

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC for EKS with 3 public and 3 private subnets across three AZs, NAT gateways, and EKS security groups.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-vpc
    Description: Name used to tag VPC resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.96.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.160.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  AvailabilityZone1:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
  AvailabilityZone2:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
  AvailabilityZone3:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1c
  EksClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-eks-cluster
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster used for subnet discovery tags.
  IngressPort1:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    Description: Custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway.
  IngressPort2:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8443
    Description: Custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway.
  IngressPort3:
    Type: Number
    Default: 9443
    Description: Custom TCP port for ingress/service mesh gateway.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone3
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZone2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-private-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/cluster/!Sub '${EksClusterName}'
          Value: shared

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: IAM execution role and policies for SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with EKS
Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix for resource names
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster
  VPCId:
    Type: String
    Description: VPC ID for the HyperPod cluster
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>
    Description: Security group IDs for the HyperPod cluster
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Private subnet IDs for the HyperPod cluster
  LifecycleScriptsBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket containing lifecycle scripts
  RIGInputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional S3 bucket for RIG input
  RIGOutputBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional S3 bucket for RIG output
  CreateRIGResources:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Whether to create RIG resources
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Whether to enable gated access
Conditions:
  CreateRIG: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateRIGResources, "true"]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGInputBucket, ""]]
  GatedAccess: !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, "true"]
  HasRIGOutput: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RIGOutputBucket, ""]]
Resources:
  HyperPodExecRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EKSCNIPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:RequestTag/k8s.amazonaws.com/createdFor: eks-kublet
        - PolicyName: HyperPodENIManagementPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
                  - !Ref VPCId
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:*:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucket}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${LifecycleScriptsBucket}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMakerHyperPodPrerequisites
          Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
  "Fn::ForEach::SubnetPolicies":
    - SubnetId
    - !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
    - "SubnetPolicy${SubnetId}":
        Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
        Properties:
          PolicyName: !Sub "HyperPodSubnetPolicy-${SubnetId}"
          Roles:
            - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:subnet/${SubnetId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:subnet/${SubnetId}"
  "Fn::ForEach::SecurityGroupPolicies":
    - SecurityGroupId
    - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
    - "SecurityGroupPolicy${SecurityGroupId}":
        Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
        Properties:
          PolicyName: !Sub "HyperPodSecurityGroupPolicy-${SecurityGroupId}"
          Roles:
            - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterface
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}"
  RIGPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateRIG
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}RIGPolicy"
      Roles:
        - !Ref HyperPodExecRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RIGInputBucket}"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RIGInputBucket}/*"
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:*:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:*:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*"
          - !If
            - GatedAccess
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:*:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*SageMaker*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:*:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/*sagemaker*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*SageMaker*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - GatedAccess
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              Resource:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasRIGOutput
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
              Resource:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RIGOutputBucket}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RIGOutputBucket}/*"
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
Outputs:
  ExecRoleName:
    Description: Name of the HyperPod execution role
    Value: !Sub "${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole"
  ExecRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the HyperPod execution role
    Value: !GetAtt HyperPodExecRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Creates three private subnets with NAT routes, NACL association, and an S3 VPC endpoint.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: The VPC in which to create the private subnets.
  NatGatewayIdAz1:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1a.
  NatGatewayIdAz2:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1b.
  NatGatewayIdAz3:
    Type: String
    Description: NAT Gateway ID for us-east-1c.
  NetworkAclId:
    Type: String
    Description: Network ACL ID to associate with all private subnets.

Resources:
  PrivateSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1a
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-us-east-1a"

  PrivateSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1b
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-us-east-1b"

  PrivateSubnetAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1c
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-us-east-1c"

  PrivateRouteTableAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-us-east-1a"

  PrivateRouteTableAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-us-east-1b"

  PrivateRouteTableAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-us-east-1c"

  PrivateRouteAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAz1

  PrivateRouteAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAz2

  PrivateRouteAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAz3

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz3

  PrivateSubnetNaclAssociationAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  PrivateSubnetNaclAssociationAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  PrivateSubnetNaclAssociationAz3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz3
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource: "*"

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-ids"

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of private route table IDs.
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-ids"

  PrivateSubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: Subnet group CIDR block.
    Value: 10.24.24.0/21
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-group-cidr"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Baseline IAM personas - groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies

Resources:
  DenyBillingAndKMSLoggingStatement:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineCommonDenies
      Description: Denies billing console access and tampering with logging KMS keys
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyBillingConsole
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - aws-portal:*
              - billing:*
              - ce:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DenyKMSLoggingKeyTampering
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - kms:DisableKey
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:DeleteAlias
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:CreateAlias
              - kms:UpdateAlias
              - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/Purpose: Logging

  AdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineAdministrator
      Description: Near-full access outside of IAM, requires MFA
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref DenyBillingAndKMSLoggingStatement
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullAccessExceptIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Action: '*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyIAM
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - iam:*
              - organizations:*
              - account:*
            Resource: '*'

  IAMAdministratorPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineIAMAdministrator
      Description: Full IAM access, requires MFA
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref DenyBillingAndKMSLoggingStatement
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: FullIAMAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action: 'iam:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'

  OpsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineOps
      Description: EC2, ELB, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling with VPC networking denies, requires MFA
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref DenyBillingAndKMSLoggingStatement
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: OpsAllow
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
              - cloudwatch:*
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'
          - Sid: DenyVPCNetworking
            Effect: Deny
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRouteTableAssociation
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:DeleteVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:AcceptVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:RejectVpcPeeringConnection
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAcl
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAcl
              - ec2:CreateNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclEntry
              - ec2:ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress

              - ec2:DeleteDhcpOptions

            Resource: '*'

    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineReadOnly
      Description: Broad read-only access across core services, requires MFA
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref DenyBillingAndKMSLoggingStatement
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:Get*
              - ec2:Search*
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Describe*
              - cloudwatch:Get*
              - cloudwatch:List*
              - logs:Describe*
              - logs:Get*
              - logs:FilterLogEvents
              - logs:ListTagsForResource
              - s3:Get*
              - s3:List*
              - dynamodb:Describe*
              - dynamodb:List*
              - dynamodb:Get*
              - lambda:Get*
              - lambda:List*
              - rds:Describe*
              - rds:List*
              - sqs:Get*
              - sqs:List*
              - sns:Get*
              - sns:List*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:List*
              - sts:GetCallerIdentity
              - cloudformation:Describe*
              - cloudformation:Get*
              - cloudformation:List*
              - iam:Get*
              - iam:List*
              - iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy
              - iam:GenerateCredentialReport
              - tag:Get*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'

  BillingReadOnlyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: BaselineBillingReadOnly
      Description: View-only billing information access
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BillingReadOnlyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - aws-portal:ViewBilling
              - aws-portal:ViewPaymentMethods
              - aws-portal:ViewAccount
              - billing:ViewBilling
              - billing:ViewPaymentMethods
              - billing:ViewAccount
              - ce:GetCostAndUsage
              - ce:GetCostForecast
              - ce:GetDimensionValues
              - ce:GetReservationCoverage
              - ce:GetReservationPurchaseRecommendation
              - ce:GetReservationUtilization
              - ce:GetSavingsPlansCoverage
              - ce:GetSavingsPlansPurchaseRecommendation
              - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
              - ce:GetTags
              - ce:GetUsageForecast
              - budgets:ViewBudget
              - cur:DescribeReportDefinitions
              - cur:GetUsageReport
            Resource: '*'

  AdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BaselineAdministratorRole
      Description: EC2-assumable administrator persona role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BaselineIAMAdministratorRole
      Description: EC2-assumable IAM administrator persona role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  OpsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BaselineOpsRole
      Description: EC2-assumable operations persona role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref OpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: BaselineReadOnlyRole
      Description: EC2-assumable read-only persona role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyPolicy

  AdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: BaselineAdministratorInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref AdministratorRole

  IAMAdministratorInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: BaselineIAMAdministratorInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorRole

  OpsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: BaselineOpsInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref OpsRole

  ReadOnlyInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: BaselineReadOnlyInstanceProfile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyRole

  AdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BaselineAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AdministratorPolicy

  IAMAdministratorGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BaselineIAMAdministrators
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref IAMAdministratorPolicy

  OpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BaselineOps
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref OpsPolicy

  ReadOnlyGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BaselineReadOnly
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyPolicy

  BillingReadOnlyGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: BaselineBillingReadOnly
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref BillingReadOnlyPolicy

Outputs:

  OpsGroupId:
    Description: ID of the Ops group

    Value: !GetAtt ReadOnlyGroup.GroupId

    Value: !GetAtt BillingReadOnlyGroup.GroupId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Three-tier VPC across three Availability Zones with NAT Gateways per AZ
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  AvailabilityZoneA:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1a
  AvailabilityZoneB:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1b
  AvailabilityZoneC:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1c
  WebSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
  WebSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/22
  WebSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.8.0/22
  AppSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/22
  AppSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/22
  AppSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.20.0/22
  DbSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.24.0/22
  DbSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.28.0/22
  DbSubnetCCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/22

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: three-tier-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneA
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: web-subnet-a

  WebSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneB
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: web-subnet-b

  WebSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnetCCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneC
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: web-subnet-c

  AppSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-subnet-a

  AppSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-subnet-b

  AppSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnetCCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-subnet-c

  DbSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-subnet-a

  DbSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-subnet-b

  DbSubnetC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnetCCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Ref AvailabilityZoneC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-subnet-c

  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: web-route-table

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnetAAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetBAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnetCAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  NatEIPA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIPB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-a

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-b

  NatGatewayC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPC.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnetC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: nat-gateway-c

  AppRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-route-table-a

  AppRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-route-table-b

  AppRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: app-route-table-c

  AppDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  AppDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayB
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  AppDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayC
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  AppSubnetAAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableA

  AppSubnetBAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableB

  AppSubnetCAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTableC

  DbRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-route-table-a

  DbRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-route-table-b

  DbRouteTableC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: db-route-table-c

  DbDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayA
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  DbDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayB
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  DbDefaultRouteC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGatewayC
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayC

  DbSubnetAAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableA

  DbSubnetBAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableB

  DbSubnetCAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnetC
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTableC

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"
  AvailabilityZones:
    Description: Availability Zones used by the VPC
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AvailabilityZoneA, !Ref AvailabilityZoneB, !Ref AvailabilityZoneC]]
  WebSubnetIds:
    Description: Web tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref WebSubnetA, !Ref WebSubnetB, !Ref WebSubnetC]]
  AppSubnetIds:
    Description: Application tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref AppSubnetA, !Ref AppSubnetB, !Ref AppSubnetC]]
  DbSubnetIds:
    Description: Database tier subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref DbSubnetA, !Ref DbSubnetB, !Ref DbSubnetC]]
