AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Cognito identity bootstrap for multi-tenant SaaS operations application

Parameters:
  TenantAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host for the tenant application callback URLs
  AdminAppCallbackHost:
    Type: String
    Description: Host for the admin application callback URLs
  SiloedTenantRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: authenticated-siloed-user-role
    Description: Name of the siloed tenant IAM role

Resources:
  PooledTenantUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: >-
            Your username is {username} and temporary password is {password}.
            Please sign in at https://${TenantAppCallbackHost} to access your tenant application.
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations tenant application

  PooledTenantAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub https://${TenantAppCallbackHost}/logout
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      WriteAttributes:
        - email
        - custom:tenantId
        - custom:userRole
      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours
        AccessToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 12

  PooledTenantUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub pooledtenant-saasoperations-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref PooledTenantUserPool

  PooledTenantIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PooledTenant-SaaSOperationsIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ProviderName: !GetAtt PooledTenantUserPool.ProviderName
          ClientId: !Ref PooledTenantAppClient
      PrincipalTags:
        tenantId: custom:tenantId
        userRole: custom:userRole
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt AuthenticatedPooledUserRole.Arn

  AuthenticatedPooledUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: authenticated-pooled-user-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TenantScopedDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantProductAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    dynamodb:LeadingKeys: "${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}"
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  SiloedTenantRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref SiloedTenantRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PooledTenantIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SiloedTenantDynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: TenantProductOrderAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Product-\${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Order-\${aws:PrincipalTag/tenantId}
              - Sid: TenantAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantUserMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantDetails
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/TenantStackMapping
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/Settings
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: TenantAdmin
              - Sid: SystemAdminAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*
                  - !Sub arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/index/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:PrincipalTag/userRole: SystemAdmin

  OperationUsersUserPool:

    Properties:
      UserPoolName: OperationUsers-SaaSOperationsUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: email

        - Name: tenantId
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: userRole
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
        - Name: apiKey
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailMessage: >-
            Your username is {username} and temporary password is {password}.
            Please sign in at https://${AdminAppCallbackHost} to access the operations admin application.
          EmailSubject: Your temporary password for the SaaS Operations admin application

  OperationUsersAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: SaaSOperationsOperationUsersPoolClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref OperationUsersUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub https://${AdminAppCallbackHost}/logout

      WriteAttributes:

        - custom:userRole

      IdTokenValidity: 12
      TokenValidityUnits:
        IdToken: hours

      AccessTokenValidity: 12

  OperationUsersUserPoolDomain:

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Reusable DynamoDB table stack with optional autoscaling, backup, encryption, streams and alarms.
Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute (required)
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+'
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Type of the partition key
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional table name. Defaults to stack name.
    Default: ''
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name
    Default: ''
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key attribute type
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttr1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttr1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttr2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttr2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  ExtraAttr3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  ExtraAttr3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
  GSI1Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional first global secondary index name
    Default: ''
  GSI1PartitionKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  GSI1SortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  GSI2Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional second global secondary index name
    Default: ''
  GSI2PartitionKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  GSI2SortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  TTLAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional Time to Live attribute name
    Default: ''
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Description: Stream view type. Disabled by default.
    Default: DISABLED
    AllowedValues:
      - DISABLED
      - KEYS_ONLY
      - NEW_IMAGE
      - OLD_IMAGE
      - NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
  ReadMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  ReadMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  ReadTargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
  WriteMinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  WriteMaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
  WriteTargetUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: true
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
  ServerSideEncryptionEnabled:
    Type: String
    Description: Enable server-side encryption with AWS managed KMS key
    Default: false
    AllowedValues:
      - true
      - false
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Backup retention in days. Set to 0 to disable backups entirely.
    Default: 30
  AlertNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Existing SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications. Leave empty to disable alarms.
    Default: ''
Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasExtraAttr1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr1Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttr2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr2Name, '']]
  HasExtraAttr3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttr3Name, '']]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1Name, '']]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2Name, '']]
  HasGSI1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKey, '']]
  HasGSI2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKey, '']]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TTLAttributeName, '']]
  StreamEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, 'DISABLED']]
  OnDemand: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PAY_PER_REQUEST']
  Provisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  EnableSSE: !Equals [!Ref ServerSideEncryptionEnabled, 'true']
  EnableBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  EnableAlerts: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn, '']]
Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-table']
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttr3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttr3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttr3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKey
            AttributeType: S
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKey
            AttributeType: S
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKey
            AttributeType: S
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2SortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKey
            AttributeType: S
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - Provisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasGSI1
        - - IndexName: !Ref GSI1Name
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKey
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1SortKey
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKey
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - Provisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasGSI2
            - IndexName: !Ref GSI2Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKey
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasGSI2SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKey
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - Provisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - StreamEnabled
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TTLAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, 'true']
      SSESpecification: !If
        - EnableSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: Provisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/DynamoDBAutoscalingPolicy'
  TableReadScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: Provisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref ReadMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref ReadMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
  TableWriteScalingTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: Provisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref WriteMaxCapacity
      MinCapacity: !Ref WriteMinCapacity
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb
  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: Provisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling-policy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref ReadTargetUtilization
  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: Provisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling-policy'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteScalingTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref WriteTargetUtilization
  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBBackupAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeContinuousBackups
                  - dynamodb:ListTables
                  - dynamodb:ListBackups
                  - dynamodb:CreateBackup
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeBackup
                  - dynamodb:DeleteBackup
                  - dynamodb:ListTagsOfResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${Table}/backup/*'
  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vault'
      Notifications: !If
        - EnableAlerts
        - SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
          BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - BACKUP_JOB_FAILED
            - COPY_JOB_STARTED
            - COPY_JOB_COMPLETED
            - COPY_JOB_FAILED
            - RECOVERY_POINT_MODIFIED
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref AWS::StackName
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-rule'
            TargetBackupVaultName: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays
  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: EnableBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt Table.Arn
  AlarmReadThrottleEvents:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: Read throttle events on the DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  AlarmWriteThrottleEvents:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: Write throttle events on the DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  AlarmThrottledRequests:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-throttled-requests'
      AlarmDescription: Throttled requests on the DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  AlarmUserErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-errors'
      AlarmDescription: User errors on the DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
  AlarmSystemErrors:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: EnableAlerts
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: System errors on the DynamoDB table
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertNotificationTopicArn
Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref Table
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
  StreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB stream
    Value: !GetAtt Table.StreamArn
    Condition: StreamEnabled

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB tables for account-vending automation with auto scaling

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: Stage suffix appended to every table name

Resources:
  DynamoDBAutoScaleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoScale
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: '*'

  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  AccountInfoTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScaleRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScaleRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoScaleRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure HA network foundation for a containerised Streamlit application

Parameters:
  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1
  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2
  PrivateSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1
  PrivateSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2CIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs'

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: flowlogs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  ECSClusterName:
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSClusterArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ECSCluster.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform with Bedrock, Step Functions, DynamoDB, KMS, HTTP API and optional OpenSearch Serverless semantic search.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-campaign
    Description: Prefix used for resource names.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
    Description: Amazon Bedrock model identifier used by generative steps.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    Description: Email address subscribed to the operational alarm SNS topic.
  SmsSenderId:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-SMS-ID
    Description: Sender identifier used for SMS channel delivery.
  PhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-PHONE-ID
    Description: Phone number identifier used for SMS/voice channel delivery.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to deploy the OpenSearch Serverless vector search capability.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for campaign platform data stores
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - dynamodb.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - logs.amazonaws.com
                - opensearchservice.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-data-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  AssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref DataKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-customer-profiles
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-channel-rate-limits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: windowId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: windowId
          KeyType: RANGE

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-delivery-tracking
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: RANGE

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-operational-alerts

  AlarmTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-userpool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/lambda/${ProjectName}-functions
      RetentionInDays: 30

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/states/${ProjectName}-orchestrator
      RetentionInDays: 30

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-sfn-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: sfn-invoke-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-lambda-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-data-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub ${AssetsBucket.Arn}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:Invoke
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*

  BaseLambdaEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::LayerVersion
    DependsOn: []
    Properties:
      LayerName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-noop
      Content:
        ZipFile: noop
      CompatibleRuntimes:
        - python3.12

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-parse-instruction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def handler(event, context):
              instruction = event.get('instruction', '')
              prompt = json.dumps({
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 1024,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"Extract campaign objective, audience and channels as JSON from: {instruction}"}]
              })
              resp = bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=os.environ['BEDROCK_MODEL_ID'], body=prompt)
              parsed = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
              return {"parsedInstruction": instruction, "campaignSpec": parsed.get('content', [{}])[0].get('text', '{}')}

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-segment-customers
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['PROFILES_TABLE'])
          def handler(event, context):
              resp = ddb.scan(Limit=100)
              return {"customers": resp.get('Items', []), "campaignSpec": event.get('campaignSpec')}

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-predict-channel
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def handler(event, context):
              customers = event.get('customers', [])
              for c in customers:
                  c['predictedChannel'] = 'email'
              return {"customers": customers, "campaignSpec": event.get('campaignSpec')}

  SafetyCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-safety-check
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"customers": event.get('customers', []), "safetyApproved": True, "campaignSpec": event.get('campaignSpec')}

  AdaptContentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-adapt-content
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BEDROCK_MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def handler(event, context):
              customers = event.get('customers', [])
              for c in customers:
                  c['adaptedContent'] = f"Hello {c.get('name', 'customer')}, this is your campaign message."
              return {"customers": customers, "campaignSpec": event.get('campaignSpec')}

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-deliver-messages
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          SMS_SENDER_ID: !Ref SmsSenderId
          PHONE_NUMBER_ID: !Ref PhoneNumberId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, uuid, boto3
          ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TRACKING_TABLE'])
          def handler(event, context):
              results = []
              for c in event.get('customers', []):
                  mid = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  ddb.put_item(Item={"messageId": mid, "customerId": c.get('customerId', 'unknown'),
                                     "channel": c.get('predictedChannel', 'email'), "status": "SENT"})
                  results.append({"messageId": mid, "customerId": c.get('customerId')})
              return {"deliveries": results, "campaignSpec": event.get('campaignSpec')}

  RecordResultsFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-record-results
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref AssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          def handler(event, context):
              key = 'campaign-results/latest.json'
              s3.put_object(Bucket=os.environ['ASSETS_BUCKET'], Key=key,
                            Body=json.dumps(event, default=str))
              return {"status": "COMPLETED", "resultsKey": key}

  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-campaign-launcher
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          sfn = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              resp = sfn.start_execution(stateMachineArn=os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN'],
                                         input=json.dumps({"instruction": body.get('instruction', '')}))
              return {"statusCode": 202, "body": json.dumps({"executionArn": resp['executionArn']})}

  CampaignStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-campaign-status
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, boto3
          sfn = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
          def handler(event, context):
              arn = (event.get('queryStringParameters') or {}).get('executionArn', '')
              try:
                  resp = sfn.describe_execution(executionArn=arn)
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"status": resp['status']})}
              except Exception as e:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})}

  DeliveryCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-delivery-callback
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TRACKING_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TRACKING_TABLE'])
          def handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              ddb.update_item(Key={"messageId": body.get('messageId', ''), "customerId": body.get('customerId', '')},
                              UpdateExpression="SET #s = :s",
                              ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"},
                              ExpressionAttributeValues={":s": body.get('status', 'UNKNOWN')})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"received": True})}

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${ProjectName}-api
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowOrigins: ['*']
        AllowMethods: ['*']
        AllowHeaders: ['*']

  HttpApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      Name: cognito-authorizer
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource: ['$request.header.Authorization']
      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience:
          - !Ref UserPoolClient
        Issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}

  LaunchRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: POST /campaign
      AuthorizationType: JWT
      AuthorizerId: !Ref HttpApiAuthorizer
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LaunchIntegration}

  StatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:

  OssVectorCollection:

    DependsOn:

      Type: VECTORSEARCH

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless URL shortener with DynamoDB, Lambda and API Gateway
Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix for Lambda function names
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.9
      - python3.10
      - python3.11
      - python3.12
    Description: Python runtime for Lambda functions
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com
    Description: Base URL used to build shortened links
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: devops
    Description: Owner tag value
Resources:
  UrlShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt UrlShortenerTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          APP_URL: !Ref AppUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import secrets
          import string
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])
          APP_URL = os.environ['APP_URL']

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Invalid JSON body'})}
              long_url = body.get('url')
              if not long_url:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'url is required'})}
              length = secrets.randbelow(5) + 12
              alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
              short_id = ''.join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(length))
              table.put_item(
                  Item={'short_id': short_id, 'long_url': long_url},
                  ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(short_id)'
              )
              short_url = f"{APP_URL.rstrip('/')}/{short_id}"
              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps({'short_url': short_url, 'short_id': short_id})
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              short_id = (event.get('pathParameters') or {}).get('id')
              if not short_id:
                  return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'id is required'})}
              resp = table.get_item(Key={'short_id': short_id})
              item = resp.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return {'statusCode': 404, 'body': json.dumps({'error': 'Not found'})}
              return {
                  'statusCode': 301,
                  'headers': {'Location': item['long_url']},
                  'body': ''
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
  ApiGatewayLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs
  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogsRole.Arn
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Type: REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: create
  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin
  LinksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: links
  ShortIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !Ref LinksResource
      PathPart: '{id}'
  CreatePostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  AdminGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  ShortIdGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'
  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApiId}/*/POST/create'
  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApiId}/*/GET/*'
  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreatePostMethod
      - AdminGetMethod
      - ShortIdGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: test
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          MetricsEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner
Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Base URL of the test stage
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApiId}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test'
  TableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref TableName
  CreateFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the create Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt CreateFunction.Arn
  RetrieveFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the retrieve Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt RetrieveFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless on-call incident alerting service

Parameters:

    Type: String

  SenderEmail:

    Description: Verified SES sender email address

      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ConfigurationKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ConfigurationKey
          KeyType: HASH

  ServicesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AppName}-services'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          KeyType: HASH

  SchedulesTable:

    Properties:

      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: IncidentId

        - AttributeName: IncidentId

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Conformance pack template implementing AWS Config operational best practices for
  Amazon CloudWatch. Includes five AWS managed Config rules: CloudWatch alarm action
  check, alarm action enabled check, alarm required check, alarm settings check, and
  CloudWatch log group encrypted check. The first four rules are scoped to
  AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm resources. All rule inputs are exposed as parameters and are
  only passed through to the rules when non-empty.

Parameters:
  AlarmActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
      - ""
    Description: Whether the alarm action check requires an alarm action (empty to omit).
  InsufficientDataActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
      - ""
    Description: Whether the alarm action check requires an insufficient-data action (empty to omit).
  OkActionRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
      - ""
    Description: Whether the alarm action check requires an OK action (empty to omit).
  AlarmRequiredMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: CPUUtilization
    Description: Metric name for the ALARM_REQUIRED rule (empty to omit).
  AlarmRequiredResourceTypes:
    Type: String
    Default: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Description: Comma-separated resource types for the ALARM_REQUIRED rule (empty to omit).
  AlarmSettingsMetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Metric name for the alarm settings check (empty to omit).
  AlarmSettingsThreshold:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Threshold for the alarm settings check (empty to omit).
  AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedValues:
      - GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      - GreaterThanThreshold
      - LessThanThreshold
      - LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      - ""
    Description: Comparison operator for the alarm settings check (empty to omit).
  AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Evaluation periods for the alarm settings check (empty to omit).

Conditions:
  HasAlarmActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmActionRequired, ""]]
  HasInsufficientDataActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref InsufficientDataActionRequired, ""]]
  HasOkActionRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OkActionRequired, ""]]
  HasAlarmRequiredMetricName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmRequiredMetricName, ""]]
  HasAlarmRequiredResourceTypes: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmRequiredResourceTypes, ""]]
  HasAlarmSettingsMetricName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSettingsMetricName, ""]]
  HasAlarmSettingsThreshold: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSettingsThreshold, ""]]
  HasAlarmSettingsComparisonOperator: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator, ""]]
  HasAlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods, ""]]
  HasAnyAlarmSettingsInput: !Or
    - !Condition HasAlarmSettingsMetricName
    - !Condition HasAlarmSettingsThreshold
    - !Condition HasAlarmSettingsComparisonOperator
    - !Condition HasAlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods

Resources:
  CloudWatchAlarmActionCheckRule:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
    Properties:
      ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-check
      Description: Checks whether the required actions are configured for CloudWatch alarms.
      Source:
        Owner: AWS
        SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
      InputParameters: !Join
        - ""
        - - "{"
          - !If
            - HasAlarmActionRequired
            - !Sub '"alarmActionRequired":${AlarmActionRequired}'
            - ""
          - !If
            - HasInsufficientDataActionRequired
            - !Sub ',"insufficientDataActionRequired":${InsufficientDataActionRequired}'
            - ""
          - !If
            - HasOkActionRequired
            - !Sub ',"okActionRequired":${OkActionRequired}'
            - ""
          - "}"
      Scope:
        ComplianceResourceTypes:
          - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

  CloudWatchAlarmActionEnabledCheckRule:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
    Properties:
      ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-action-enabled-check
      Description: Checks whether actions are enabled for CloudWatch alarms.
      Source:
        Owner: AWS
        SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK
      Scope:
        ComplianceResourceTypes:
          - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

  AlarmRequiredRule:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
    Properties:
      ConfigRuleName: alarm-required
      Description: Checks whether a CloudWatch alarm exists for the specified metric and resource type.
      Source:
        Owner: AWS
        SourceIdentifier: ALARM_REQUIRED
      InputParameters: !Join
        - ""
        - - "{"
          - !If
            - HasAlarmRequiredMetricName
            - !Sub '"metricName":"${AlarmRequiredMetricName}"'
            - ""
          - !If
            - HasAlarmRequiredResourceTypes
            - !Sub ',"resourceTypes":"${AlarmRequiredResourceTypes}"'
            - ""
          - "}"
      Scope:
        ComplianceResourceTypes:
          - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

  CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheckRule:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
    Properties:
      ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-alarm-settings-check
      Description: Checks whether CloudWatch alarms have the specified settings for a given metric.
      Source:
        Owner: AWS
        SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
      InputParameters: !If
        - HasAnyAlarmSettingsInput
        - !Join
          - ""
          - - "{"
            - !If
              - HasAlarmSettingsMetricName
              - !Sub '"metricName":"${AlarmSettingsMetricName}"'
              - ""
            - !If
              - HasAlarmSettingsThreshold
              - !Sub ',"threshold":"${AlarmSettingsThreshold}"'
              - ""
            - !If
              - HasAlarmSettingsComparisonOperator
              - !Sub ',"comparisonOperator":"${AlarmSettingsComparisonOperator}"'
              - ""
            - !If
              - HasAlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods
              - !Sub ',"evaluationPeriods":"${AlarmSettingsEvaluationPeriods}"'
              - ""
            - "}"
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Scope:
        ComplianceResourceTypes:
          - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm

  CloudWatchLogGroupEncryptedRule:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
    Properties:
      ConfigRuleName: cloudwatch-log-group-encrypted
      Description: Checks whether CloudWatch log groups are encrypted at rest with AWS KMS.
      Source:
        Owner: AWS
        SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED

Outputs:
  CloudWatchAlarmActionCheckRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm action check rule.
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchAlarmActionCheckRule
  CloudWatchAlarmActionEnabledCheckRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm action enabled check rule.
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchAlarmActionEnabledCheckRule
  AlarmRequiredRuleName:
    Description: Name of the alarm required rule.
    Value: !Ref AlarmRequiredRule
  CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheckRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm settings check rule.
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheckRule
  CloudWatchLogGroupEncryptedRuleName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group encrypted rule.
    Value: !Ref CloudWatchLogGroupEncryptedRule
